Det er en fordel, hvis du er RAB-registreret, men det er ikke et krav. Har du færre uddannelsestimer, men stærke praktiske kompetencer og relevant erfaring, hører vi også meget gerne fra dig.

Hvem er vi?

Massage Experterne er en professionel massageklinik med fokus på kvalitet, grundighed og resultater.

Vores klienter kommer blandt andet med muskelspændinger, sportsskader, smerter og stressrelaterede gener. Vi lægger vægt på et roligt og tillidsfuldt behandlingsmiljø, hvor klienterne føler sig i trygge og kompetente hænder.

Som behandler bliver du en del af et sammentømret team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og prioriterer både faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til:

job@massageexperterne.dk

Fortæl kort om din uddannelse, din erfaring med massage og hvorfor du gerne vil være en del af Massage Experterne. Ansøgningen behøver ikke være lang.

Du kan læse mere om jobbet og om os her:

www.massageexperterne.dk/massage-job

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende og kontakter relevante kandidater hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Massage Therapist Wanted for a Permanent Full-Time Position in Frederiksberg – Maximum 30 Hours per Week

Are you passionate about making a real difference in people’s lives through massage?

Massage Experterne is a busy clinic, and we are currently looking for two skilled and dedicated massage therapists to join our team in Frederiksberg.

We offer proper employment conditions, a solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay, and a working week designed with an understanding of how physically demanding massage therapy can be. For this reason, a full-time position with us consists of no more than 30 hours per week.

You will enjoy a busy working environment with plenty of clients, supportive colleagues and opportunities for continuous professional development.

About the Position

You will primarily treat private clients at our clinic in Frederiksberg. We also work with several companies where we provide on-site corporate massage.

Treatments mainly consist of therapeutic and deep-tissue massage, focusing on areas such as:

  • Muscle tension and pain

  • Neck, shoulder and back problems

  • Sports injuries and overuse injuries

  • Stress-related tension

  • Improved mobility and well-being

The clinic will be your permanent base, although the position may also include occasional corporate massage shifts.

What We Offer

  • A permanent full-time position of no more than 30 hours per week

  • A solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay

  • An employment contract and proper working conditions

  • A busy, well-run clinic with plenty of clients

  • Financial security and stable employment

  • Ongoing professional support from skilled and experienced colleagues

  • Workshops, courses and opportunities for professional development

  • Social events and a strong sense of teamwork

  • A workplace focused on quality, results and employee well-being

Who We Are Looking For

  • You are a qualified massage therapist or physiotherapist

  • You have experience with therapeutic or deep-tissue massage

  • You are able to provide treatments to a high professional standard

  • You are professional, welcoming and comfortable communicating with clients

  • You are reliable and able to work independently and in a structured manner

  • You speak either Danish or English to a good standard

It is an advantage if you have completed at least 250 hours of massage training or are RAB registered, but this is not a requirement. If you have completed fewer training hours but possess strong practical skills and relevant experience, we would still be very pleased to hear from you.

Who Are We?

Massage Experterne is a professional massage clinic focused on quality, thoroughness and results.

Our clients visit us with issues including muscle tension, sports injuries, pain and stress-related discomfort. We prioritise creating a calm and trusting treatment environment where clients feel safe and in capable hands.

As a therapist, you will become part of a close-knit team where we support one another and prioritise both professional development and a positive working environment.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@massageexperterne.dk

Tell us briefly about your qualifications, your experience with massage and why you would like to become part of Massage Experterne. Your application does not need to be long.

You can learn more about the position and our clinic here:

www.massageexperterne.dk/massage-job

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will contact suitable candidates as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Firefighting Service Engineer; Location DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you an experienced service engineer with a background in offshore operations and hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems? At Semco Maritime, we keep critical safety systems running on some of the world's most demanding offshore installations — and we're looking for someone who takes pride in doing that well.

Your position
As a Firefighting Service Engineer in our Technology Solutions division, you will join a close-knit Service Team based at our Global HQ in Esbjerg, Denmark. Your work will directly support the safety and reliability of offshore energy operations worldwide — from routine maintenance to complex troubleshooting in the field.

This is a full-time position with significant international travel (100+ days per year). If you thrive in a varied, hands-on role where no two weeks look the same, this could be a strong fit.

”This is a great opportunity to work worldwide with high performance fire protection systems, take on complex challenges and build valuable experience in a specialised engineering field” – Nikolaj Søegaard, Manager, Service Firefighting

Your tasks & responsibilities
You will be responsible for the delivery, coordination, and execution of firefighting service and maintenance across our on- and offshore client base. Day-to-day, this includes:
  • Servicing, troubleshooting, and supervising firefighting systems (Water Mist, Deluge, Foam, Argonite, and others)
  • Planning and executing maintenance and installation work onshore and offshore
  • Preparing and reviewing work packages, including Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS)
  • Providing remote technical support and contributing to tenders and quotations
  • Building client relationships and identifying service opportunities
  • Upholding health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities

Your profile & qualifications
We're looking for someone who is technically solid, safety-conscious, and comfortable working independently in demanding environments. You likely have:
  • A technical qualification in engineering or a related discipline (mechanical and/or electrical)
  • 1–5 years of experience in the offshore industry
  • Hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems in an operational setting
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with clients
  • Relevant offshore certifications (e.g. BOSIET/OPITO) — or willingness to obtain them
  • Experience with work package preparation and safety documentation (RAMS)
  • The ability and willingness to travel 100+ days per year and work offshore

What we offer
You will be joining a high-performing, international team where safety culture is genuinely lived, not just stated. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, and your base will be at our Esbjerg HQ — on the waterfront, at the heart of the Danish energy industry. As Semco Maritime continues to expand our service capabilities, there are real opportunities to grow with us.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Produktionsmedarbejder skiftehold
description:

For vores samarbejdspartner i Gandrup søger Randstad en alsidig produktionsmedarbejder til en rolle både på lageret men også skiftevis i produktionen fungerende på et fast skiftehold dag og aften. title: Lagerchef søges til vores detail-, engros- og webshoplager
description:
Vi er en familiedrevet detail- og engrosvirksomhed med speciale i asiatiske fødevarer. Fra vores lager i Albertslund servicerer vi engroskunder, vores 6 forretninger i Storkøbenhavn og et webshoplager med daglige forsendelser.

Virksomheden vokser, og vi leder efter en lagerchef, der ikke bare vil drive lageret, men bygge det op. Du får ansvaret for en afdeling, der endnu ikke har fundet sin endelige form – og friheden til at forme den.

I oktober 2026 flytter vi til et større lager, fire minutters kørsel fra den nuværende adresse. Du kommer til at planlægge og stå i spidsen for flytningen og indretningen. Det er en sjælden mulighed for at tegne arbejdsgangene fra bunden i stedet for at overtage en andens.

Rollen

Du får det daglige ansvar for et lille team af 6 lagermedarbejdere og to chauffører. Kort fortalt handler dit arbejde om tre ting:

  • Drift – at lageret kører stabilt hver dag: varemodtagelse, pluk, udlevering og rettidige leverancer til butikker og engroskunder. Du har hovedansvaret for fødevarehygiejne, egenkontrol og lagerstatus.

  • System – at finde de bedre måder at gøre tingene på. Du ser, hvor arbejdet hober sig op, forstår hvorfor, og bygger processer, der holder – også når der er travlt.

  • Mennesker – at lede et lille team med ro og klar retning, og selv gå forrest i det praktiske arbejde.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med butikschefer, indkøb, og salg, og en stor del af jobbet er at få logistikken til at hænge sammen på tværs af dem.

Hvem vi leder efter

Vi leder efter en, der tænker og handler. Du kan overskue en travl hverdag uden at miste blikket for helheden, og du kan bygge struktur, hvor der ikke er nogen i forvejen. Du forstår, at et velfungerende lager ikke opstår af sig selv – det designes.

Konkret forventer vi, at du:

  • har erfaring med ledelse af lager, logistik og distribution

  • kan prioritere skarpt, når flere ting trækker i dig på én gang

  • selv opdager, hvad der kan gøres bedre – og gør noget ved det

  • leder roligt og troværdigt og løfter dem omkring dig

  • er omhyggelig og bevarer ordenssans, uanset hvor travlt det er

  • har gyldigt B-kørekort og truckcertifikat og er vant til at køre begge dele

  • taler, læser og skriver dansk og engelsk ubesværet

Du er ikke bange for at give en hånd med i det daglige, og du forstår dynamikken i en virksomhed, hvor tingene går hurtigt – men hvor det netop derfor er dit ansvar at bevare overblikket.

Som mindre virksomhed er vi afhængige af, at alle møder stabilt op og tager rollen som forbillede alvorligt. Vi lægger vægt på, at du optræder professionelt, ydmygt og roligt, og at du sætter en tone, der løfter resten af teamet.

Vi tilbyder

Et stort ansvarsområde og en alsidig hverdag med varierede opgaver i et lille team. Du får reel indflydelse på, hvordan afdelingen skal se ud – og plads til at bygge den.

Jobbet er fysisk krævende, så god form er en forudsætning.

Kendskab til asiatiske fødevarer er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er indstillet på at lære mange nye varer at kende – ofte mærket på et eller flere fremmedsprog.

Hvis dette lyder som noget for dig, ser vi frem til at høre fra dig.

Ved ansøgning pr. mail bedes du i emnefeltet notere "DKK Lagerchef".

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

title: Pædagog til børnehus
description:
Pædagog til børnehaveafdelingen i Børnehuset Tømmergrunden.

Kan du se magien i en pind, der bliver til et sværd? Har du lyst til at tage børn med ud i naturen, synge på cykelturen og måske ende med at brøle som en bjørn midt i en fantasifuld leg?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

I Børnehuset Tømmergrunden søger vi en pædagog til vores børnehaveafdeling – en kollega, der brænder for at skabe en hverdag fyldt med nærvær, leg, fællesskab og udvikling. Hos os er børnene nysgerrige, hverdagen er levende, og vi tror på, at de bedste læringsmiljøer opstår, når engagerede voksne tør være en aktiv del af børnenes verden.

Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab

Vi er et hus, hvor både børn og voksne skal trives. Vi tror på, at høj faglighed og godt humør går hånd i hånd. Derfor er der plads til at stille spørgsmål, være nysgerrig på egen og andres praksis og dele både succeser og de ting, vi stadig øver os på.

Vi prioriterer refleksion, sparring og udvikling, fordi vi ved, at ingen bliver færdiguddannede som pædagoger – vi udvikler os hele livet. Samtidig fylder grin, humor og arbejdsglæde meget hos os. Vi hjælper hinanden og fejrer de små øjeblikke i hverdagen.

Verden er større end vores legeplads

Vi elsker at komme ud af huset. Med el-cykler og bus tager vi på ture til blandt andet Ugandaskoven og Amager Fælled, hvor børnene får oplevelser i naturen og mulighed for at udforske verden med hele kroppen.

Vi samarbejder også med biblioteket, naturskolen og andre lokale kulturtilbud, som giver os spændende projekter og nye perspektiver i hverdagen.

Du bliver en del af en mangfoldig personalegruppe

Hos os møder du erfarne pædagoger, nyuddannede kolleger, PAU'er, pædagogmedhjælpere og studerende – fælles for os er, at vi hjælper hinanden og tror på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen.


Vi forventer at du…

  • møder børnene med nærvær, varme og engagement.
  • har lyst til at være en aktiv medspiller i legen – også når det betyder, at du skal være bjørn, astronaut eller pirat.
  • bidrager med faglig refleksion og nysgerrighed.
  • tager ansvar for fællesskabet og er en stabil og loyal kollega.
  • har lyst til at udvikle både læringsmiljøer og dig selv.

Til gengæld får du…

  • en hverdag sammen med de skønneste børnehavebørn.
  • engagerede og fagligt ambitiøse kolleger.
  • synlig, nærværende og tilgængelig leder.
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling – både fagligt og socialt.
  • fast tid til refleksion, planlægning og sparring.
  • en positiv og engageret forældregruppe.
  • mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på udviklingen af vores legeplads og læringsmiljøer.


Er du nyuddannet? Perfekt. Har du mange års erfaring? Også perfekt.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, hvor længe du har været pædagog – men at du har lyst til at være en del af vores fællesskab og skabe en tryg, inspirerende og udviklende hverdag for børnene.

Er du blevet nysgerrig og vil vide mere om jobbet, eller ønsker du en rundvisning af vores skønne hus -så kontakt vores leder Sarina Matz på 24938632 eller på mail sam.bhtom.bk@taarnby.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst med BUPL efter forhandling.

Kommunens ansættelsespolitik indebærer, at der ved ansættelse indhentes referencer fra tidligere og nuværende arbejdssteder. Har du været ansat i Tårnby Kommune, vil der altid blive taget reference herfra. Der skal desuden ved ansættelse forevises straffeattest og indhentes børneattest. Ansættelsen vil være betinget af, at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Tårnby Kommune tilbyder en række personalegoder. Disse kan ses her.

Er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om arbejdet som pædagog i Tårnby Kommune se her.

Tårnby Kommune har et værdigrundlag, som du kan læse her.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at Tårnby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

title: Cater / Ernæringsassistent til MARTECs kantiner
description:
Brænder du for dejlig velsmagende mad, smukt pyntede fade, friskbagt brød og kager, så er vi måske stedet for dig, vi sætter familielivet og fritidsinteresser i perspektiv, med gode arbejdstider og skemalagt weekendplan.

Vi er et team på 11 engagerede medarbejdere, som søger en ny ven til flokken. Vi søger efter, en person som tager ansvar, møder dagen med smil og gnist, har en udstråling og en gennemtrængende lyst til at forkæle vores kolleger og elever, med lækre anretninger, koldt som varmt, friskbagt brød og kager.  Du kan få noget lækkert ud af beden og pastinakken, samt få salatbaren til at udstråle ”kom og spis mig” du er personen som for alt i verden har stolthed for erhvervet og jobbet. Vi kvitterer med en dejlig broget flok kolleger med godt humør og en god- uhøjtidelig omgangstone.

Om jobbet

Som ansat i vores kantine er du ansat på en 37 timers kontrakt, du får en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du fortrinsvis arbejder på MARTEC Kragholmen, hvor vores storkøkken ligger, med mulighed for at være en del af vores anretter kantine med disksalg på MARTEC Hånbækvej.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil indeholde:

Det kolde køkken: Smørrebrød, pålægsfade, morgenbord, aftenbord, platter, anretninger, m.m.
Salaten: lækker salatbar og blandede salater, syltede grønsager og meget mere.
Bageriet: Friskbagt brød og kager.
Det varme køkken: Daglige tilberedning af dagens menu samt vegetar ret, samt prep til dagene efter.

Typiske arbejdstider

Mandag til torsdag: 07:00 – 14:30 & fredag 7:00-14:00

Aftenvagter 11:30-19:00 forekommer varierende for sæson.

Weekendvagt ca. hver 5 uge (weekend vagter er skemalagt 6 måneder frem ad gangen).

Hvem er du?

  • Du er uddannet Cater eller Ernæringsassistent. Gerne med en bred faglig erfaring.

  • Du har erfaring fra lignende stilling, eller erfaring fra produktion med stordrift. Dog ikke et krav.

  • Du har passion for madlavning og vil ikke nøjes, du har interesse for at levere kvalitet hver dag.

  • Tager ansvar og sætter dig ind i hverdagen, planlægger og organisere dit arbejde.

  • Du trives i en travl hverdag og bidrager til den gode stemning.

  • Du er klar til at tage ansvar og arbejde sammen med dine kollegaer i en dynamisk hverdag.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

  • 37 timers stilling med plads til familielivet.

  • Spændende varieret ugemenu med mulighed for medbestemmelse.

  • Gode arbejdsforhold i en dynamisk virksomhed.

  • Løn efter gældende overenskomst.

  • God pensionsordning og Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Personalegoder som fitness, biograf, svømmehal, m.fl.

  • En flok kolleger, der brænder for deres arbejde og hinanden.

Lyder vi som nogle personer og en virksomhed, du kunne blive inspireret af og som du kunne tænke dig en hverdag sammen med? Så send din ansøgning og CV via linket og bliv en del af vores stærke team. 

Søg stillingen her

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så send en mail til Køkkenchef, Morten Røhl-Grønbech på mrg@martec.dk.

Ansøgningen skal sendes gennem ovenstående link for at komme i betragtning!

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. september Vi afvikler løbende samtaler.

Tiltrædelse: hurtigst muligt

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Kitchen  Chef
description:
Vi har travlt og søger Kok til at indgå i vores køkkenteam i Køge, Greve og Slagelse.

Du er uddannet kok, gerne med erfaring fra enten hotel, restauration eller catering.

Du vil får grundigt oplæring og vi sørger for, at du løbende får ledelsestræning, så du bliver
endnu bedre til at drive og udvikle køkkenet.

Dine daglige opgaver er bl.a.:

  • Samarbejde med køkkenpersonale
  • Bestilling og modtagelse af varer
  • Opfølgning og tilsyn med takeaway
  • Opfølgning af gæsternes mad i restauranten.

Du er glad, og smilende i din tilgang til andre mennesker, gæster såvel som kollagaer, også når der er rigtigt travlt.

Dine arbejdstimer ligger indenfor 12-22 og bliver fordelt via vagtplan.

Det er et krav at du behersker engelsk. I køkkenet arbejder flere forskellige nationaliteter og
restaurantpersonalet er fortrinsvis danskere.

Har du ikke hørt fra os indenfor 14 dage, er det fordi jobbet er blevet besat.

 

Chef
We are busy and are looking for a Chef to join our kitchen team in Køge, Greve and
Slagelse.
You are a trained chef, preferably with experience in the hotel, restaurant, or catering.
You will receive thorough training and we will ensure you continuously receive management training, so you become even better at running and developing the kitchen.

Your daily tasks include:

  • Cooperation with kitchen staff
  • Ordering and receiving goods
  • Follow-up and supervision of takeaway
  • Follow-up of the guests' food in the restaurant

You are happy and smiling in your approach to other people, guests as well as colleagues,
even when it is really busy.
Your working hours are between 12-22 and are distributed with a shift schedule.
It is a requirement that you master in English. Several different nationalities work in the kitchen and the restaurant staff are mainly Danes.
If you have not heard from us within 14 days, it is because the job has been filled.

title: Finance Assistant, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our newest team member as a Finance assistant, ready to deepen your expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive finance team? DESMI is an innovative and global company where your ideas matter. We are building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning and making a difference. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Detail-oriented and structured
  • Curious and proactive in improving processes
  • Comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholder.

A glimpse into the role
As a Finance assistant, you’ll be a key contributor to ensuring accurate and efficient processes across DESMI’s Danish entities and several European subsidiaries. Your role is central in maintaining high data quality, securing timely payments, and supporting internal stakeholders with relevant financial information.

Your role mainly revolves around:
  • Administration of customer master data and ensuring accuracy across systems
  • Risk assessment and credit insurance for customers
  • Written and verbal dunning activities toward customers
  • Order release and coordination of collection processes, including handling cases with external debt collection partners
  • Close dialogue with Sales and Service to ensure alignment and smooth processes

Your next opportunity starts here
We are looking for someone who is structured, reliable, and able to work independently — while also contributing to a positive and supportive team culture. You enjoy working in a role with broad contact across the organization and take pride in delivering high-quality financial processes.

We also imagine that you:
  • Have experience working with mid/large companies within credit assessment, accounts receivable or similar fields, preferable in an international company
  • Hold an education within finance, office administration, accounting, or have equivalent practical experience
  • Are comfortable working in Excel and have basic familiarity with Word and Outlook
  • Preferably have experience with Microsoft Dynamics D365FO (not required but an advantage)
  • Communicate confidently in English due to frequent international contact
  • Ideally also understand German (not required)

The perks of being at DESMI
At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.
  • Flexible working hours and good work–life balance
  • A collaborative work culture with room for humor, openness and shared solutions
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development
  • Global career perspectives as part of an international organization
  • Access to canteen, sports activities and social events

What we’re about
At DESMI, teamwork and innovation drive success. We have a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together and ideas are always welcome.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve industries worldwide — from Aquaculture and Green Technologies to Defense. We focus on developing high-performance, long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Here, doers thrive — if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

Ready to apply?
If you're a motivated, structured and solution-oriented individual seeking a role where you can contribute directly to DESMI’s financial operations, we encourage you to apply!

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Electrical Engineer - High Voltage; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
description:
Are you searching for a place to work where you can truly make a difference and have a leading role in our continued expansion? A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Head of Solution Engineering, PLM – Jesper S. Rytke +45 2721 9705.
We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

title: Vi udvider og søger 3 stærke B2B-sælgere – opstart hurtigst muligt!
description:
Vi udvider og søger 3 stærke B2B-sælgere – opstart hurtigst muligt!

3 x Salgskonsulenter til Proff.dk – Verv ApS (Tilst, Aarhus)

Vi har rygende travlt og skruer op for væksten! Derfor udvider vi salgsteamet og skal bruge 3 nye knivskarpe kolleger, der er klar til at smøge ærmerne op og rykke ind på kontoret med det samme.

Er du resultatorienteret, og vil du repræsentere et af Danmarks mest anerkendte erhvervsbrands? Hos Verv ApS leder vi efter dig, der brænder for B2B-salg og vil være med til at drive salget af Proff.dk – Danmarks førende portal til erhvervs- og virksomhedsinformation.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Stærk lønpakke: En fast garantiløn på 115 kr. i timen kombineret med en attraktiv provisionsordning på 45 % uden loft. Din indsats og dine resultater afspejler sig direkte på lønsedlen.

  • Et brand, der åbner døre: Du skal sælge et velkendt produkt. Beslutningstagerne kender allerede Proff.dk, hvilket giver dig høj troværdighed fra første sekund i røret.

  • Professionelle rammer: Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team i Tilst med fokus på tæt sparring, salgstræning og fælles succes. Vi løfter i flok og fejrer resultaterne sammen!

Hvem er du?

Om du har flere års erfaring med B2B-salg, eller om du har et medfødt salgstalent og det rette drive, er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din indstilling.

  • Du trives med opsøgende salg og kan skabe tillid hos beslutningstagere.

  • Du arbejder struktureret, er en stærk teamplayer og motiveres af klare mål.

  • Du vil være en del af et ambitiøst forretningsmiljø (læs mere om os på www.verv.dk).

Drop den lange ansøgning – grib telefonen!

Vi ved, at de bedste sælgere er bedst i direkte dialog. Derfor overflødiggør vi den traditionelle, lange ansøgning. Da vi skal bruge 3 nye sælgere med opstart hurtigst muligt, afholder vi samtaler løbende.

Ring eller skriv til oss i dag og sikr dig en af pladserne:

  • Kontaktperson: Maria Larsen

  • Telefon: 51 23 85 20

  • E-mail: maria.larsen@verv.dk

title: Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Technically grounded
  • Possess strong leadership and people management skills
  • Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
  • Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
  • Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
  • Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
  • Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
  • Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
  • Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
  • Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
  • Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
  • Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
  • Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
  • Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
  • Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
  • Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
  • Pension – attractive employer contributions
  • Private healthcare and life insurance
  • On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
  • Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
  • A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
  • A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer for Renewables; Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
description:
Do you want to play a leading role in transforming the global energy sector from fossil fuels to renewable? Then this is your chance. Join us! 

Your position
In your new position as Electrical Engineer in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the dedicated High Voltage Equipment team who is responsible for driving designs, installations, tests and commissioning of medium- and high voltage projects for large and specialized offshore substation projects. 

We are looking for an experienced specialist or an ambitious individual aiming to become an expert in High Voltage Equipment for offshore use. You will collaborate with highly skilled colleagues and can play a crucial role in designing offshore substations, from the tender phase through to commissioning.

Here, you will work with some of the brightest and most skilled engineers in developing technical solutions to our customers all over the world. You will have the exciting chance to bring your knowledge into work in the core area of high voltage systems. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You may choose working from our head office in Esbjerg or our Nordhavn office close to the centre of Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect 10-30 travel days per year.

“As part of the high voltage team, we get to contribute to some of the largest offshore substations the world has ever seen. You will travel to different countries and will be working with team members from multiple cultures. Further you will have the opportunity to involve in both the theoretical and practical aspects of offshore wind farm projects. This is done in an informal atmosphere with high focus on knowledge sharing and development,” says Colleagues from the Electrical department. 

Your tasks & responsibilities
In the role you will be responsible for driving part of the high voltage scope of the projects. You will be the technical design responsible of own scope and in cooperation with the project team oversee compliance of the time schedule and budget, to ensure the project's successful completion.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • Responsible for design, calculations and engineering of HV/MV equipment in our EPC projects.
  • Handling suppliers, negotiations and contracts in cooperation with the project team and procurement department.
  • Planning and potentially attending FAT, HAT, SAT, commissioning and handover of projects to clients and their O&M organisation.
  • Developing, optimizing and standardizing technical solutions, as well as participating and supporting tenders.

Your profile & qualifications
As a person you are dedicated and proud of what you do, you are trustworthy, positive and a team player. Furthermore, you should be able to collaborate with both external and internal stakeholders and have a proactive, analytical and organized approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we expect you to have:
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Electrical Power Systems or Electrical Installation Engineer.
  • Experience in designing high voltage components such as High- and Medium Voltage GIS and oil-immersed equipment.
  • Practical experience in the installation, testing, and commissioning of high voltage equipment, as well as knowledge of offshore design requirements, is beneficial.
  • An understanding of project management and detailed engineering from offshore substations or other relevant electrical projects.
  • Can communicate in English, both verbal and written.
  • You should be the go-to person for technical clarifications and possess a good sense of humour, which is always appreciated at Semco Maritime.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,400 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 
We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis starting from end of August due to holiday season in Denmark, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact Thomas V. M. Christiansen, Manager of the High Voltage Equipment Team at mail: tvmn@semcomaritime.com

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593
  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?

Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk
Learn more about us:
https://mmm-rc.dk/
Instagram:
@bornogkolstrup
Learn more about ZBC:
https://www.zbc.dk
We look forward to hearing from you! Application deadline 16/8-26

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

title: Bogholder / accountant: Vil du have styr på tallene hos en virksomhed i grøn vækst?
description:
(English below)

Hos SteamGreen ApS søger vi en struktureret og selvkørende bogholder, der vil tage ansvaret for vores daglige økonomifunktion. Hvad enten du leder efter en fuldtidsstilling eller ønsker fleksibiliteten ved en deltidsstilling (f.eks. 15–25 timer om ugen), skræddersyr vi gerne rammerne, så det passer til din hverdag.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Daglig bogføring, kontering samt afstemning af bank, debitorer og kreditorer.

  • Håndtering af fakturering, betalinger og rykkerprocedurer.

  • Momsindberetning og klargøring af månedlige perioderegnskaber.

  • Lønadministration samt håndtering af refusioner.

  • Forberedelse af regnskabsmateriale til ekstern revisor ved årsafslutning.

  • Løbende optimering og digitalisering af vores interne økonomiprocesser.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har solid erfaring fra en lignende rolle som bogholder eller regnskabsansvarlig.

  • Du er rutineret i gængse økonomisystemer (f.eks. e-conomic, Danløn eller lignende) og har et godt kendskab til Excel.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og sætter en ære i, at tingene stemmer til punkt og prikke.

  • Du har en løsningsorienteret tilgang og trives i et miljø, hvor du selv tager initiativ.

Hvad tilbyder SteamGreen ApS?

  • Høj fleksibilitet: Mulighed for enten deltid eller fuldtid samt en fleksibel arbejdstid, hvor der også kan aftales delvis hjemmearbejde.

  • Stort ansvar: Du får fuldt ejerskab over økonomifunktionen og direkte indflydelse på hverdagen.

  • Uformelt arbejdsmiljø: Du bliver en del af et engageret og uformelt team med korte kommandoveje og højt til loftet.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer: Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke, der matcher dine erfaringer og kompetencer.

Ansøgning og kontakt Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til info@steamgreen.dk mærket "Bogholder".

ENGLISH

_______________________________________________________________________________________

Do you want to take charge of the numbers at a growing green company?

At SteamGreen ApS, we are looking for a structured and self-driven Bookkeeper to take responsibility for our daily financial operations. Whether you are looking for a full-time position or prefer the flexibility of a part-time role (e.g., 15–25 hours a week), we are happy to tailor the framework to fit your everyday life.

  • You have solid experience from a similar role as a bookkeeper or accounting officer.

title: Kreditor- og administrationsassistent
description:
Har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med en hverdag, hvor administration og økonomi går hånd i hånd?

Hos Kids-World søger vi en engageret og struktureret kreditor- og administrationsassistent til vores økonomiafdeling.

Stillingen kombinerer kreditorbogholderi, ejendomsadministration og øvrige administrative opgaver. Fælles for opgaverne er, at de kræver struktur, overblik og en god økonomisk forståelse.

Du bliver en del af en mindre økonomiafdeling, hvor du får et bredt ansvarsområde og sammen med dine kolleger er med til at sikre en effektiv og velfungerende økonomi- og administrationsfunktion på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

En væsentlig del af stillingen er den daglige håndtering af kreditorprocessen via digitale workflows. Du håndterer undtagelser, følger op på manglende godkendelser, sikrer korrekt kontering og momsbehandling samt afklarer eventuelle afvigelser i dialog med både leverandører og kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

Samtidig får du ansvaret for en række administrative opgaver inden for koncernens bolig- og erhvervsejendomme, herunder huslejeopkrævning, lejekontrakter og den løbende dialog med lejere, håndværkere og leverandører.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Registrering, kontering og betaling af kreditorfakturaer.

  • Løbende bogføringsopgaver og vedligeholdelse af bogholderiet for koncernens ejendomme.

  • Administration af en portefølje af bolig- og erhvervsejendomme.

  • Udarbejdelse og administration af lejekontrakter samt oprettelse af ejendomme og lejere i vores systemer.

  • Huslejeopkrævning, varsling og regulering af husleje samt opfølgning på restancer.

  • Udarbejdelse af forbrugsregnskaber samt administration af vand- og varmeregnskaber.

  • Løbende dialog og samarbejde med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører, viceværter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Vedligeholdelse af data og dokumentation i Business Central, Boligflow og øvrige administrative systemer.

  • Administrative og økonomiske ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af koncernens selskaber.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde i Business Central og Boligflow. Erfaring med et eller begge systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære nyt og trives med digitale arbejdsprocesser – vi sørger naturligvis for en grundig oplæring.

 

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en administrativ eller økonomisk funktion, hvor du har arbejdet med både administrative og regnskabsmæssige opgaver. Du behøver ikke være uddannet bogholder eller ejendomsadministrator, men du har en god forståelse for, hvordan administration og økonomi hænger sammen, og du motiveres af at få tingene til at fungere.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Trives med en hverdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste rutiner, mens andre varierer.

  • Har en god økonomisk og regnskabsmæssig forståelse og arbejder sikkert med kreditorhåndtering, opkrævninger og afstemninger. Har du erfaring med moms, er det en fordel.

  • Trives med administrative opgaver og motiveres af at skabe orden og overblik.

  • Arbejder struktureret, omhyggeligt og har blik for detaljen.

  • Har let ved at skabe gode relationer og kommunikerer naturligt og professionelt med lejere, håndværkere, leverandører og kolleger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men trives samtidig i et mindre team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Har flair for IT og lyst til at lære nye systemer. Erfaring med Business Central, Boligflow eller lignende systemer er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Hvorfor os?

Hos Kids-world er vi et team på 115 dedikerede medarbejdere, som alle brænder for at gøre en forskel. Vi værdsætter fleksibilitet, personlig udvikling og et arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet. Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel – og vi sørger for, at der er plads til både seriøsitet og sjov i hverdagen!

Det Praktiske

Vi tilbyder en fast stilling på 30-37 timer ugentligt i vores afdeling Administration & Økonomi i vores domicil i Esbjerg. Vi har frokostordning, som du til en fordelagtig pris kan blive en del af. Kaffe/te samt frugt er også til fri afbenyttelse.

Du bliver ansat under HK’s overenskomst, med løn efter kvalifikationer og hos os får du bl.a. pensionsordning, fritvalgskonto, mulighed for sundhedsforsikring, 5 feriefridage samt mulighed for fordelagtige køb i shoppens varesortiment.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV, som du kan sende til jobs@kids-world.dk. Marker mailen med "Administration og økonomi".

For at sikre en god forventningsafstemning fra start, beder vi dig oplyse dit forventede lønniveau i din ansøgning. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og opslaget vil blive fjernet, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Alle ansøgninger vil blive behandlet fortroligt.

Jannie Tofte på tlf: 32173575

title: Tale- høre- sprogkonsulent/logopæd til Det Rådgivende Team – (PPR)
description:
Har du lyst til at være en del af et udviklende team, der går professionelt til opgaveløsningen og som vægter, at vores personlige egenskaber og kompetencer er i spil? Har du en bachelor og/eller kandidat i audiologopædi eller diplom i logopædi? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af Det Rådgivende Team (PPR) i Haderslev Kommune.

I Det Rådgivende Team arbejder vi samskabende i forhold til at udvikle inkluderende læringsmiljøer, hvor barnets trivsel, læring og udvikling er i centrum. 

Som tale- høre- sprogkonsulent i Det Rådgivende Team indgår vi i mange samarbejdsrelationer, og opgaverne er mangfoldige og spændende. Kollegial sparring og vidensdeling er en integreret del af vores hverdag, og vi værner om tværfaglighed. Vi arbejder i høj grad konsultativt med vejledning, rådgivning og sparring, samt direkte med barn/forældre i tale/høreundervisning. Derudover arbejdes der med testning, observationer og udarbejdelse af rapporter som et led i de forebyggende og foregribende indsatser.

Vi er et udviklingsorienteret team, der er optaget af at understøtte omgivelsernes møde med børn og unge i udsatte positioner.

  • Sammen med skoleområdet deltager vi i et flerårigt kompetenceudviklingsforløb omkring co-teaching og neuropædagogik, hvor vi arbejder som et professionelt læringsfællesskab. 

  • Sammen med dagtilbudsområdet har vi netop afsluttet et kompetenceudviklingsforløb ved Tea Thyrre, hvilket vi er optaget af at omsætte sammen med 0-6 års området herunder kvalificering af den pædagogiske praksis.

  • Vi har fokus på at skabe udvikling af mangfoldige læringsmiljøer, så børn og unge møder læringsmiljøer, hvor de oplever, at de er i privilegerede positioner. 

  • Vi er i proces omkring vores serviceniveau, hvor vi arbejder med tilpasningen af vores praksis i forhold til den service, vi tilbyder. 

Organisatorisk er Det Rådgivende Team opdelt i tre distrikter (Nord, Vest og Syd), der hver især er tværfagligt sammensat af psykologer/psykologiske konsulenter, pædagogiske konsulenter, skolerådgivere, fysioterapeuter, ergoterapeuter, tale-høre-sprogkonsulenter, fraværskonsulenter og en afdelingsleder. Vi har en matrix organisering, som betyder, at du også vil indgå i en monofaglig gruppe med tale- høre- sprogkonsulenter fra de to øvrige distrikter, og vi holder fast i, at vi er ét Rådgivende Team, hvor vi understøtter hinanden i opgavevaretagelsen. Du vil indgå i arbejdet i Distrikt Syd.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • kan yde rådgivning og vejledning til forældre, skoler og daginstitutioner med henblik på at fremme børn og unges deltagelsesmuligheder i læringsmiljøet

  • er optaget af at bidrage til en nuanceret forståelse af barnets ressourcer og behov samt understøtte det pædagogiske læringsmiljø omkring barnet

  • har en bred og generel viden om sprogproblematikker som høre-, stemme- og udtalevanskeligheder

  • har viden om eller ønsker at opnå kendskab til diagnosers betydning for barnets tale- og sproglige udvikling

  • er optaget af at inddrage barnets familie og netværk i helhedsorienterede løsninger

  • kan gennemføre relevant testning af sprog og tale samt formidle resultaterne til en praksisnær kontekst

  • kan formidle fagfaglig viden til eksterne og interne samarbejdspartnere samt holde overblik over komplekse sagsforløb

  • selvstændigt kan tilrettelægge og udføre kortere konsultative undervisningsforløb med børn, unge og deres familier.

Vi kan tilbyde: 

  • et spændende og alsidigt job i en udviklingsorienteret organisation

  • fagligt dygtige, kompetente og engagerede kolleger, der vægter refleksion, vidensdeling, et godt arbejdsklima og tværfagligt samarbejde højt

  • fleksible forhold og en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • en udfordrende hverdag med alsidige opgaver indenfor hele børne- og familieområdet.

Ansættelsesforhold
Der er tale om en fast stilling på 32 timer med tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter. 

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Du ansættes ved Haderslev Kommune.

title: Innovation Project & Partnership Specialist
description:
Real climate action requires more than good intentions. It requires connection, innovation, and unstoppable momentum.

As an Innovation Project & Partnership Specialist at Hydrogen Valley DK (CEMTEC), you will be a catalyst for decarbonizing Europe's energy systems. You won't just manage projects; you will connect the right minds, secure crucial funding, and help build the resilient, sustainable infrastructure our future depends on.

Hydrogen Valley DK (CEMTEC) is a non-profit knowledge broker and project enabler for resilient, decentralised energy systems, located in Hobro, North Jutland, with focus on EU-funded research and innovation. We identify societal and industrial challenges and match them with innovation, partners and funding.

THE ROLE

We're looking for an Innovation Project & Partnership Specialist to strengthen our work with Danish and European innovation projects, including Horizon Europe, LIFE, EUDP and Interreg. In this role, you will help identify new opportunities, create partnerships and contribute to the development of collaborative innovation projects. Working closely with colleagues, companies, municipalities, universities and international partners, you will connect societal and industrial challenges with the right people, ideas and funding.

You'll play a key role in building and maintaining the partnerships that underpin our projects while helping ensure that project activities continue to move forward. Moreover, you’ll enjoy a high degree of independence, with the freedom to take initiative, develop your own network and help shape future collaborations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Coordinate and follow up on CEMTEC's participation in EU and national projects

  • Identify, scout and build relationships with potential partners for current and future projects

  • Represent Hydrogen Valley DK at meetings, conferences and partner events

  • Support stakeholder engagement and co-creation ahead of project deployment

  • Help track funding calls and support proposal development (Horizon Europe, LIFE, EUDP, Interreg and others)

  • Contribute a problem-first perspective: connecting societal and industrial challenges to the right innovation and the right people

WHO YOU ARE

  • Extroverted and energized by building relationships and networks

  • Curious and proactive, with an eye for identifying new opportunities for collaboration

  • Self-driven and comfortable working independently, without close supervision

  • Motivated by climate impact and the green transition, and able to turn that into concrete project work

  • Structured enough to keep project commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups on track

  • Comfortable operating across sectors: research institutions, industry, municipalities, and EU-level bodies

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Relevant background in engineering, environmental science, business or a related field

  • Fluent English, required for EU project work; Danish is a strong plus

  • Experience with or strong interest in energy systems, sustainability, and innovation project work

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders and collaborative projects is an advantage.

PRACTICALITIES

  • Based in Hobro, North Jutland: physical presence required, with flexibility to work from home some days

  • Full-time position.

  • Valid driving license and willingness to travel occasionally (domestic and EU)

To apply, send your CV and a short motivation to ansoegning@hydrogenvalley.dk by Aug 30th, 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Der kan være mange indgange til jobbet. Ideelt set har du erfaring som kirketjener eller en anden funktion med kirkelige handlinger.

Derudover er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Har overblik og ordenssans og tager naturligt ansvar for dine opgaver, som du selvstændigt løser.

Der er pligt til at gøre tjeneste ved andre ansættelsesmyndigheder i i overensstemmelse med de aftaler menighedsrådet indgår med andre ansættelsesmyndigheder.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgave som kirketjener, graver, kirkegårdsleder eller stor administrationschef indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på https://folkekirkensintranet.dk/vejledninger/menighedsraadet-som-arbejdsgiver/ok24.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 322.596,68 kr. – 406.233,97 kr. (nutidskroner).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.018,72 kr. (nutidskroner).

OK tillæg på 1.391,59 kr. (nutidskroner) pr. år.

Bemærk: de oplyste beløb er ved en fuldtidsstilling. Løn, OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk. Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.

https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):

  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
