title: Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d) (Talent-Acquisition-Manager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. Beyond leading day-to-day recruiting operations, you will drive recruiting projects, mentor recruiters, and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and delivery. This role offers a long-term career path with the opportunity to grow into a broader Talent Acquisition leadership position within Gas Services as organizational responsibilities evolve.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Strategic partnership with business leaders and hiring managers across a complex global matrix organization to develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities
* Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
* Leadership of Talent Acquisition projects and support of organizational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the global Talent Acquisition organization
* Analysis of recruiting metrics and market insights to identify optimization opportunities and drive data-informed decisions that enhance recruiting effectiveness and process excellence
* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment
* Proven experience leading recruiting projects and successfully navigating complex matrix organizations with multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong project management skills and experience driving recruiting or organizational transformation initiatives.
* High data affinity with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions using applicant tracking systems and recruiting analytics
* Sound understanding of collective bargaining agreements (tariff structures), experience collaborating with Works Councils, and familiarity with governance processes in a corporate environment
* Professional proficiency in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

employer: Hotel Deimann GmbH & Co. KG Hotel Deimann
description:
Es ist noch früh am Nachmittag, als in der Küche des Hotel Störmann die ersten Töpfe auf den Herd kommen. Ein Blick auf den Tagesplan, ein kurzer Austausch über die Abendkarte, dann beginnt die Vorbereitung – ruhig, konzentriert, mit der Erfahrung vieler Service-Abende im Rücken. Mitten in der historischen Altstadt von Schmallenberg, in einem Haus, das seit Generationen für herzliche Gastfreundschaft steht und seit einigen Jahren zur Familie Deimann gehört, treffen Tradition und moderne Hotelküche aufeinander. Hier kennt man sich, hier verlässt man sich aufeinander, und hier hat Ihr Posten seinen festen Platz im Ablauf des Abends. Als Chef de Partie übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Ihren Bereich der Küche – mit dem Rückhalt eines eingespielten Teams und der Gelassenheit eines Hauses, das weiß, was es kann.

Aufgaben

- Sie sorgen dafür, dass auf Ihrem Posten alles vorbereitet ist, bevor der erste Teller den Pass verlässt.
- Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr handwerkliches Können dort ein, wo aus guten Zutaten verlässlich gute Gerichte entstehen.
- Sie behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Bestellungen gleichzeitig auf Ihren Posten kommen.
- Sie achten auf Sauberkeit, Qualität und die Einhaltung der Hygienestandards, ohne dass es jemand extra ansprechen muss.
- Sie stimmen sich mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen an den anderen Posten ab, damit jeder Teller zur richtigen Zeit den Pass erreicht.

title: Chef de Partie (m/w/d) - Hofstube Deimann (1 Michelin-Stern) (Fachkraft - Gastronomie (Restaurantservice))
employer: Hotel Deimann GmbH & Co. KG Hotel Deimann
description:
Die Küche wird ruhiger. Jeder Handgriff sitzt. Die letzten Komponenten werden abgeschmeckt, angerichtet, noch einmal kontrolliert. Hinter dem Pass der offenen Küche beginnt gleich der Abend – und jeder Teller trägt die Handschrift des Teams. In der Hofstube Deimann, dem einzigen Sternerestaurant im Sauerland, kocht Küchenchef Felix Weber mit seinem kleinen, eingespielten Team einen modernen, französisch inspirierten und puristischen Stil, bei dem wenige, aber ausgesuchte Produkte im Mittelpunkt stehen. Die Gäste sitzen nah an der Küche, sehen jeden Schritt – und genau diese Nähe verlangt Präzision, ohne dabei die Ruhe zu verlieren. Als Chef de Partie übernehmen Sie hier Verantwortung für Ihren Posten in einem Team, das auf höchstem Niveau arbeitet, sich aber nie über die eigene Sache stellt.

Aufgaben

- Sie sorgen dafür, dass auf Ihrem Posten alles vorbereitet ist, bevor der erste Teller den Pass verlässt.

- Sie halten die Qualitätsstandards unseres Gourmetrestaurants konsequent ein, auch wenn der Abend hektisch wird.
- Sie gehen sorgfältig mit hochwertigen, saisonalen Produkten um und wissen, was jede Zutat ausmacht.
- Sie arbeiten eng mit Küchenchef Felix Weber, dem Sous Chef und dem übrigen Team zusammen.
- Sie bringen eigene Ideen und Ihre fachliche Erfahrung ein, wenn Gerichte weiterentwickelt werden.
- Sie unterstützen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung des Menüs und lernen dabei stetig dazu.
- Sie behalten auch in der offenen Küche, direkt vor den Augen der Gäste, einen kühlen Kopf.

Qualifikation

- Sie haben Ihre Ausbildung als Koch oder Köchin erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Sie bringen Berufserfahrung als Chef de Partie oder in einer vergleichbaren Position mit.
- Sie stellen hohe Ansprüche an Qualität und Handwerk – an sich selbst genauso wie an Ihre Gerichte.

title: Sozialarbeiter:in / Sozialpädagog:in (m/w/d) (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Sozialarbeiter:in / Sozialpädagog:in (m/w/d)

Kreis 74 e.V. Bielefeld

Umfang: Teilzeit (19,25 Wochenstunden)

Anstellungsverhältnis: Befristet für 1 Jahr mit Option auf Übernahme

Bewerbungsfrist: 30.08.2026

Die Brücke Bielefeld ist ein Arbeitsbereich des Kreis 74 e.V. und begleitet straffällig gewordene Jugendliche und Heranwachsende im Rahmen ambulanter Maßnahmen des Jugendgerichtsgesetzes (JGG). Im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit stehen die pädagogische Begleitung, die Förderung von Verantwortungsübernahme sowie die Entwicklung tragfähiger Perspektiven für ein straffreies Leben.

Sie möchten junge Menschen in belasteten Lebenslagen professionell unterstützen, mit unterschiedlichen Kooperationspartnern zusammenarbeiten und in einem anspruchsvollen Arbeitsfeld verantwortungsvoll tätig sein? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Ihre Aufgaben

- Durchführung von Weisungen und Auflagen im Rahmen des JGG.
- Beratung, Begleitung und Einzelbetreuung von Jugendlichen und Heranwachsenden.
- Konzeption, Planung und Durchführung von pädagogischen Gruppenangeboten.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Jugendgericht, der Jugendhilfe im Strafverfahren (JGH) und weiteren Netzwerkpartnern.
- Dokumentation sowie Erstellung fachlicher Stellungnahmen und Berichte.
- Teilnahme an Fallbesprechungen, Supervisionen und Teamsitzungen.
- Mitwirkung an der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung des ambulanten Angebots.

Sie bringen mit

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Sozialen Arbeit / Sozialpädagogik (Bachelor, Master oder Diplom) mit staatlicher Anerkennung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Freude an der Beziehungsarbeit mit jungen Menschen in herausfordernden Lebenslagen.
- Fachliches Interesse und Offenheit für die Arbeit mit sexualdelinquenten Menschen (inkl. zeitweiser Vertretungsaufgaben im Erwachsenenbereich).
- Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
- Bereitschaft, teamintern als Ansprechperson für alltägliche IT-Fragen (z. B. MS Office, Standard-Hardware, Einrichtung von Druckern/Laptops) zu unterstützen.
- Idealerweise Vorerfahrung in der Straffälligenhilfe, der Jugendhilfe oder angrenzenden Arbeitsfeldern.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine verlässliche und fachlich vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem engagierten, multiprofessionellen Team.
- Ein Arbeitsverhältnis mit Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TV-L.
- Regelmäßige Supervision, Intervision und gezielte Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.
- Eine gründliche und strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Wir leben Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Identität oder Lebensweise.

Bewerbung

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen per E-Mail an: bewerbung@kreis74.de

Diakoneo ist eines der größten Gesundheits- und Sozialunternehmen in Deutschland. - Fort- und Weiterbildung: persönliches Bildungsbudget, Coaching & Supervision, unternehmenseigene Akademie (https://www.dialogakademie.de/)  sowie ein breites Angebot an E-Learnings in der Diakoneo Learning Zone
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Zusatzversicherung
- Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben: gemeinsame Planung der Arbeitszeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- Sinnstiftender Arbeitsplatz mit Tradition
- Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen: unter anderem Jahressonderzahlung, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Mitarbeitenden Rabatte

Erfahren Sie mehr über unsere Benefits auf: www.diakoneo.de/vorteile (https://www.diakoneo.de/karriere/warum-fuer-diakoneo-arbeiten)

Ihre Aufgaben

- Sie übernehmen die pädagogische Begleitung und Assistenz von Menschen mit Behinderung in deren Wohnung mit dem Ziel der Inklusion am Wohnort Gunzenhausen und Umgebung.
- Dabei richten Sie den Fokus auf den Erhalt, Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung der Selbstständigkeit der Kund*innen.
- Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Team des Begleiteten Wohnens, Angehörigen, gesetzlichen Betreuer*innen und Fachstellen zusammen.
- Zudem führen Sie eine gewissenhafte digitale Dokumentation Ihrer Tätigkeit und erstellen Berichte.

- Ein sehr gutes Einfühlungsvermögen in die Belange von Menschen mit Behinderung, zeichnet Sie aus.
- Zuverlässigkeit, Sorgfalt und Teamgeist sind für Sie selbstverständlich.
- Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, kundenorientiert und im Sinne der Inklusion.
- Außerdem haben Sie einen Führerschein der Klasse B sowie einen privaten Pkw, den Sie bei Bedarf für Ihre Tätigkeit benötigen.

description:
Diakoneo ist eines der größten Gesundheits- und Sozialunternehmen in Deutschland. OFFENE HILFEN WEISSENBURG-GUNZENHAUSEN

Unser Team in Weißenburg freut sich ab 15. September 2026 auf Sie!
(Teilzeit 10-12 Stunden / Woche | befristet bis 31.07.2027)

Die Offenen Hilfen bieten ein vielfältiges Betreuungs-, Beratungs- und Bildungsangebot für Menschen mit und ohne Beeinträchtigung im Sinne der Inklusion. Niedrigschwellige Betreuungsangebote unterstützen Familien mit unterschiedliche Assistenzleistungen, wie z. B. dem familienentlastenden Dienst und Freizeitassistenz sowie Individualbegleitung oder Schulbegleitung. Damit schaffen wir Freiräume für Familien und fördern die Teilhabe am gesellschaftlichen Leben.

Wir bieten

- Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung: Sport- und Entspannungsangebote, Möglichkeit auf ein Jobrad (je nach Vertragsgestaltung) und betriebsärztliche Beratung
- Fort- und Weiterbildung: persönliches Bildungsbudget, Coaching & Supervision, unternehmenseigene Akademie (https://www.dialogakademie.de/)  sowie ein breites Angebot an E-Learnings in der Diakoneo Learning Zone
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Zusatzversicherung
- Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben: gemeinsame Planung der Arbeitszeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- Sinnstiftender Arbeitsplatz mit Tradition
- Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen: unter anderem Jahressonderzahlung, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Mitarbeitenden Rabatte

Erfahren Sie mehr über unsere Benefits auf: www.diakoneo.de/vorteile (https://www.diakoneo.de/karriere/warum-fuer-diakoneo-arbeiten)

Ihre Aufgaben

- Sie begleiten eine Schülerin mit Körperbehinderung 2-3 Schultage pro Woche an der Altmühlfrankenschule in Weißenburg in Zusammenarbeit mit einer weiteren Kollegin.
- Sie fördern Inklusion, ermöglichen die Teilhabe am gesellschaftlichen Leben und leisten Assistenz zur Selbstständigkeit.
- Sie arbeiten zudem eng mit dem Team der Offenen Hilfen, der Schule sowie den Eltern zusammen, um eine bestmögliche Unterstützung sicherzustellen.

- Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Kinderpfleger (m/w/d) oder Heilerziehungspflegehelfer (m/w/d) und bringen pädagogisches Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kindern mit.

- Zuverlässigkeit, Sorgfalt und Vertrauenswürdigkeit sind für Sie selbstverständlich.
- Sie zeigen Akzeptanz gegenüber Vielfalt und leben den Gedanken der Inklusion.

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit steht das diakonische Profil. Wir handeln empathisch, mutig, vielfältig und inklusiv. Entdecken Sie, was uns als Arbeitgeber besonders macht: www.diakoneo.de/werte (https://www.diakoneo.de/ueber-uns#c142432)

description:
Willkommen im Ringhotel Drees Dortmund – wo Gastfreundschaft von Herzen kommt

Mitten in Dortmund erwartet unsere Gäste ein familiengeführtes 4-Sterne-Hotel mit persönlicher Atmosphäre, regionaler Küche und einem starken Teamgeist.

Ob im Restaurant „Neunzehn30“ oder in unserer Pilsstube „Alte Gasse“ – bei uns steht echter Service und ein herzliches Miteinander im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort:

Servicemitarbeiter (m/w/d) für unser Restaurant „NEUNZEHN30“

Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, arbeitest gerne im Team und möchtest unseren Gästen eine gute Zeit bereiten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

** Werde Teil eines Hauses, in dem Gäste zu Freunden werden – und Mitarbeitende geschätzt werden.**

Worauf Sie sich freuen können

- eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung inklusive Sonn- und Feiertagszuschlägen
- zusätzliches Trinkgeld durch eine faire und transparente Trinkgeldregelung
- pünktliche und zuverlässige Gehaltszahlungen
- frühzeitige Dienstplanung für eine bessere Planung Ihrer Freizeit
- klare, zusammenhängende Arbeitszeiten ohne Teildienst
- Mitarbeiterrabatte innerhalb des Hauses
- eine gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr
- ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima in einem familiären und motivierten Team
- einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz
- eine strukturierte Einarbeitung
- Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, familiengeführten 4-Sterne-Hotel

Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

Als Servicemitarbeiter sind Sie nah am Gast und tragen wesentlich dazu bei, dass sich unsere Gäste willkommen, gut beraten und rundum betreut fühlen.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:

- Sie empfangen unsere Gäste freundlich und sorgen von Beginn an für eine angenehme Atmosphäre
- Sie nehmen Bestellungen auf und beraten zu Speisen, Getränken sowie aktuellen Empfehlungen
- Sie servieren Speisen und Getränke aufmerksam, fachgerecht und mit Blick fürs Detail
- Sie sorgen gemeinsam mit Küche und Bar für einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Service
- Sie bereiten den Gastraum vor und halten den Servicebereich gepflegt und einladend
- Sie übernehmen Kassiertätigkeiten und arbeiten sicher mit gängigen Kassensystemen
- Sie gehen professionell und lösungsorientiert mit Gästewünschen und Reklamationen um
- Sie achten auf Sauberkeit und halten die geltenden Hygienevorschriften ein
- Sie unterstützen die allgemeinen Abläufe im Servicebereich und bringen sich aktiv ins Team ein

Was Sie mitbringen

Für uns zählt nicht nur der Lebenslauf, sondern vor allem Ihre Freude am Service und Ihr Gespür für Gäste.

Wir freuen uns, wenn Sie:

- idealerweise eine Ausbildung in der Gastronomie oder Hotellerie abgeschlossen haben oder bereits Erfahrung im Service mitbringen
- freundlich, gepflegt und serviceorientiert auftreten
- gerne im Team arbeiten und zuverlässig sind
- auch in stressigen Situationen ruhig und organisiert bleiben
- flexibel einsetzbar sind und Bereitschaft zu Schicht-, Wochenend- und Feiertagsdiensten mitbringen
- über gute Deutschkenntnisse verfügen; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
- idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kassensystemen haben

Join the Amazon DACH team and drive category growth of the Amazon MCC DACH and WER business by building an irresistible experience for first time parents within Amazon as part of the wholistic CXJ – leveraging data, automation and AI

- Develop and maintain an optimized product selection for online sales, analyzing pricing strategies, stock levels, and product information to maximize basket value and conversion rates on Amazon
- Collaborate with local and regional stakeholders to define and execute the e-commerce sales strategy for Philips
- Optimize e-commerce fundamentals by facilitating core e-commerce activities, utilizing data analytics to identify areas for improvement and implement changes that enhance the CXJ and ultimately sales performance and profitability
- Research new methods and procedures to improve e-commerce efficiency and effectiveness, championing innovative approaches to drive online sales growth
- Analyze and report sales results, market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior, identifying key insights and translating them into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement powered by automations and AI
- Execute daily sales operations on Amazon by monitoring budgets, planning promotional activities, and ensuring adherence to targets
- Provide expert product knowledge and support by acting as a resource for colleagues with product and e-commerce best practices

- You are excited about building an irresistible consumer experience

title: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Kontakt: Dr. Simone-Franziska Glaser, Head of Research of the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center
Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **
Bewerbungsfrist: 06.09.2026

We are looking forward to your complete application, including your CV, a motivation letter and your relevant certificates and references.

We welcome applications from candidates of all genders. Women are currently underrepresented in these positions at Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt. Therefore, applications from women are especially encouraged. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal personal and professional qualifications.

title: Sozialarbeiter:in (m/w/d) für Schülerberatung und Kompetenzförderung - Hans-Böckler-Schule (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Die Gesellschaft für Jugendbeschäftigung (https://gjb-frankfurt.de/ueber-gjb/) (gjb) unterstützt seit fast 30 Tagen junge Menschen bei der beruflichen Orientierung und Ausbildung. An beruflichen Schulen in Frankfurt bieten unsere sozialpädagogischen Fachkräfte individuelle Unterstützung bei persönlichen und schulischen Herausforderungen. Unser Ziel ist es, Schüler:innen in ihrer Lebensplanung zu begleiten, sie persönlich zu stabilisieren und ihre Ausbildungsbereitschaft zu erhöhen.

Starten Sie zum 01.09.2026 oder später bei uns als

Sozialarbeiter:in (m/w/d) für Schülerberatung und Kompetenzförderung – Hans-Böckler-Schule –

in Teilzeit (19,5 Wochenstunden). Die Schulferien sind arbeitsfrei, die notwendige Arbeitszeit dafür wird während der Schulzeit entsprechend vorgearbeitet. Arbeitsort: Hans-Böckler-Schule (https://www.hans-boeckler-schule.eu/)

- Sie führen Trainings/Workshops zu sozialer und personaler Kompetenz, Kommunikation und Lernstrategien durch und beraten Schüler:innen (BzB) sowie deren Eltern.
- Sie konzipieren und realisieren Klassentrainings in Kooperation mit Lehrkräften.
- Sie kooperieren eng mit der Schule, Fachdiensten, Ämtern und sozialen Institutionen.
- Sie sind Ansprechperson für den Schutzauftrag (§ 8a SGB VIII).
- Sie dokumentieren Beratungen, erstellen Statistiken und Berichte.

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Studium Sozialarbeit/Sozialpädagogik (gemäß Fachkräftegebot)
- Erfahrung in der Beratung von Jugendlichen sowie ausgeprägtes Interesse an ihren Lebenswelten
- Kenntnisse des sozialen Hilfesystem der Stadt Frankfurt am Main
- Hohe soziale und kommunikative Kompetenz, Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative, Organisationsstärke, Flexibilität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
- Bereitschaft zur Weiterqualifizierung

Wir bieten

Guter Start: Strukturierte Einarbeitung und feste Ansprechpersonen

Verlässliche Strukturen: Anbindung an ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team der gjb und gleichzeitig fester Bestandteil der Schulgemeinschaft

Gestaltungsspielraum: Raum für eigene Ideen, kurze Entscheidungswege und Mitgestaltung in Arbeitsgruppen

Digitale Ausstattung: Laptop und Handy – mobiles Arbeiten ist in begrenztem Umfang möglich

Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Fortbildungen, Supervision und kollegiale Fallberatung

Vergütung nach TVöD SuE (EG S12): inklusive Jahressonderzahlung und monatlicher Zulage (in Anlehnung an TVöD Kommunen)

Urlaubs- und Ferienregelung: 30 Urlaubstage plus 2 Regenerationstage (bei Vollzeit); zusätzlich arbeitsfrei am 24. und 31. Dezember; schulferienfrei (ermöglicht durch Urlaubstage und Vorarbeitszeit)

Mobilität: Bezuschusstes RMV-Jobticket mit Mitnahmeregelung, Fahrradleasing möglich

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet – eine langfristige Weiterbeschäftigung ist jedoch vorgesehen.

Gesellschaft für Jugendbeschäftigung e.V.
Laura Stemmler I Personaladministration
Mainzer Landstraße 293
60326 Frankfurt am Main
bewerbung@gjb-frankfurt.de (https://mailto:bewerbung@gjb-frankfurt.de)

while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Supply Chain Planning: Project Management Specialist (m/f/d) (Demand Planner)
description:
About OSI

OSI Europe is a leading company in the food industry, specializing in the production of high-quality food products. With several production sites in Europe and a global distribution network, we offer first-class solutions for customers worldwide.

Our European Headquarter in Gersthofen is looking for a** Project Management Specialist (m/f/d). **Possible other locations: Bábolna, Toledo, Ostróda, Enns, Günzburg, Duisburg.

- Responsibility over cost or efficiency evaluation projects: Volume movements, backup validations, contingency plans

- Support the Digitalization of our Planning Team: SOP process, periodical KPI sharing, stock levels
- Support the SAP IBP Implementation bridging central and local functions

- A university degree in Supply Chain / Manufacturing / Continuous improvement related fields
- CPIM, Six Sigma, WCM, Green belt trainings are a plus
- Significant experience in in multinational manufacturing environment in Supply Chain / Planning / Continuous Improvement positions
- Significant proactivity and autonomy
- Excel, Power Point and ERP systems

- Good communication skills with various ranges of stakeholders

- Fluency in English, additional EU language preferred

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. - Fantastic canteen

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures/ and put "260714-06" in the field for employer.
Last application date is August 14, 2026

description:

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

description:

Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

description: Grafton LifeScience* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Sales&Marketing, Clinical Research, Regulatory e Operation dei settori Farmaceutico e Medicale e per le mansioni legate all'assistenza al cliente del mondo distributivo con impatto sulla salute (Farmacie e Parafarmacie). Opera nel canale farmacia e si caratterizza per un approccio orientato a ricerca e innovazione e a una collaborazione continuativa con i professionisti della salute. title: contabile
description: Per nota e solida realtà editoriale, sono alla ricerca di un* Accounting Expert che, riportando direttamente al CFO, si occuperà in autonomia della gestione della contabilità generale della società e delle principali attività di carattere fiscale. Nello specifico si occuperà di: - Gestione del bilancio, redazione della nota integrativa, contabilità clienti, fornitori e generale; - Fatturazione attiva Italia/estero; - Gestione delle liquidazioni IVA mensili, verifiche su detraibilità IVA, stampa registri IVA, ritenute e supporto al consulente fiscale per la predisposizione delle LIPE e dichiarazione IVA; - Verifiche periodiche schede contabili e quadrature; - Adempimenti di fine anno utili alla predisposizione del bilancio, collaborazione e supporto al commercialista esterno; - Supporto ai revisori dei conti nelle verifiche periodiche; - Interfaccia con l'ufficio diritti e una risorsa dedicata dell'amministrazione per la gestione dei rendiconti - Supporto al CFO per esigenze di reporting/bilancio/audit della società di revisione; La figura ricercata dovrà possedere i seguenti requisiti: - Diploma di ragioneria o laurea in economia; - Consolidata esperienza in ambito amministrativo e fiscale maturata in aziende o Studi Professionali; - Competenza in contabilità generale e degli adempimenti fiscali, sia periodici che annuali; - Capacità di lavorare in modo autonomo - Conoscenza delle procedure amministrativo-contabili, principi contabili OIC; - Rispetto delle scadenze, propositività e forte senso di responsabilità - Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Si offre: Contratto a tempo indeterminato, full time. È prevista una Retribuzione Annua Lorda indicativamente di €55-60.000, da valutare in funzione del profilo del candidato. Ticket restaurant da 8€ Sede di lavoro: Milano centro, non è prevista la possibilità di lavorare da remoto. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: specialista di marketing
description: Grafton Office* per Coop, tra i principali operatori della distribuzione italiana, è alla ricerca di giovani neolaureati interessati a intraprendere un percorso di carriera manageriale all'interno delle Cooperative di consumatori. Coop Next New Generation: un percorso di sviluppo manageriale I partecipanti saranno assunti fin da subito con contratto a tempo indeterminato e avranno l'opportunità di avviare il proprio percorso professionale in una delle principali aree strategiche delle cooperative di consumo, tra cui: Marketing, Comunicazione e Relazioni con i soci Rete di vendita e Sviluppo Supply Chain Risorse Umane Sostenibilità e Innovazione Amministrazione, Finanza e Controllo IT e Organizzazione Coop Next New Generation nasce per creare non solo professionisti preparati nell'ambito della grande distribuzione, ma persone capaci di interpretare la leadership come responsabilità verso la comunità per rafforzare il legame tra giovani generazioni e cooperazione di consumo. Per questo Coop ha sviluppato un Talent Program dedicato a giovani neolaureati che desiderano costruire un percorso professionale in un modello di impresa capace di coniugare sostenibilità, innovazione, attenzione alle persone e al territorio. Cosa prevede il Talent Program: Master Universitario di II livello, realizzato in collaborazione con l'Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, presso la sede di Cremona, dedicato alla formazione dei futuri professionisti e manager delle Cooperative di consumatori; Acquisizione di competenze manageriali, strategiche, gestionali e organizzative; Moduli sulla cultura delle Cooperative di consumatori e sul ruolo di retail marketing, innovazione, Big Data, design thinking e intelligenza artificiale nello sviluppo strategico e nella creazione di valore per soci e comunità; Alternanza con esperienze dirette presso le Cooperative di consumatori per consolidare sul campo le competenze acquisite; Retail tour all'estero per conoscere da vicino l'esperienza europea delle Cooperative di consumatori. Cosa offre Coop: Assunzione a tempo indeterminato dal primo giorno del Talent Program; Partecipazione gratuita al Master Universitario di II livello organizzato dall'Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore - SMEA, Alta Scuola di Management ed Economia Agro-alimentare, in 'Management della cooperazione di consumo'; Copertura integrale dei costi di residenzialità previsti per la frequenza del Master; Crescita professionale all'interno delle Cooperative di consumatori. È l'opportunità giusta per te se: Hai conseguito una laurea magistrale o a ciclo unico; Sei disponibile alla mobilità territoriale; Ti riconosci come una persona desiderosa di lavorare in un modello di impresa che mette al centro persone, innovazione e impatto; Hai buone capacità relazionali e ti piace lavorare in contesti collaborativi; Sei motivato/a ad assumere progressivamente responsabilità e a contribuire alla crescita di un'organizzazione complessa e dinamica. Il contratto prevede: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato. CCNL: Distribuzione Cooperativa Livello di inquadramento: IV livello RAL annua pari a: 25.700 € Sono inoltre previsti assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, previdenza integrativa, accesso a quanto disciplinato dalla contrattazione aziendale o dai regolamenti. title: consulente in energia solare
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante realtà operante nel settore tessile. Per il potenziamento della funzione Sales, siamo stati incaricati di ricercare la seguente figura professionale: Export Area Manager - Tessile La risorsa, in coordinamento con la Direzione Commerciale, sarà inserita in un percorso di sviluppo volto ad assumere progressivamente responsabilità sui mercati assegnati, con particolare attenzione ai mercati esteri. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

Kunne du se dig selv bo i en af Baltikums mest spændende hovedstæder, arbejde i et internationalt miljø og være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor ingen dage er helt ens?

Lige nu søger vi dansktalende Game Presenters til Riga, Letland.

Det er en unik mulighed for dig, der gerne vil prøve livet i udlandet, møde mennesker fra hele verden og arbejde i en branche, hvor kommunikation, energi og personlighed er i centrum.

Du behøver ikke tidligere erfaring – du får grundig og betalt oplæring, inden du starter.

OM JOBBET

Som Game Presenter bliver du ansigtet udadtil for online casinospil som blackjack, roulette og poker.

Du guider spillerne gennem spillene foran kameraet og sørger for, at alt foregår professionelt og underholdende.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

• Præsentere og styre forskellige online casinospil

• Guide og kommunikere med spillere foran kameraet

• Sikre, at spillene forløber korrekt og professionelt

• Samarbejde med kollegaer og ledelse i det daglige

• Bidrage til en positiv og energisk atmosfære på arbejdspladsen

Der er tale om præsentation og underholdning – ikke salg eller kundeservice.

HVORFOR RIGA?

Riga er en moderne og international hovedstad med masser af liv, kultur og historie.

Byen byder på hyggelige caféer, et aktivt natteliv, smuk arkitektur og et stort internationalt fællesskab af unge mennesker, som arbejder og studerer fra hele Europa.

Mange flytter til Riga alene, men bliver hurtigt en del af et socialt miljø med nye venner og oplevelser.

✈️ Betalt flybillet til Letland

Gratis indkvartering den første måned

Betalt oplæring inden opstart

Sundhedsforsikring

Betalt ferie

Gode udviklings- og karrieremuligheder internt

Sociale arrangementer og internationale events

En arbejdsplads med medarbejdere fra hele verden

Hjælp til at finde bolig efter ankomst

HVEM ER DU?

• Taler og forstår dansk

• Du kan kommunikere på engelsk

• Du er udadvendt og trives med at være i centrum

• Du føler dig komfortabel foran et kamera

• Du er positiv, energisk og lærenem

• Du har lyst til at prøve livet i udlandet

Erfaring er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er imødekommende, har gode kommunikationsevner og lyst til at udvikle dig.
