title: Gestionnaire Contentieux & Faillites
description:
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
FER CIAM "" L'humain au centre des prestations sociales  
La FER CIAM est l'agence genevoise de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse FER Genève, créée par la FER Genève et pleinement intégrée dans son écosystème de services aux entreprises membres.  
Avec près de 47'500 affiliés "" entreprises et indépendants confondus "" elle est l'un des acteurs incontournables de la protection sociale en Suisse romande.  
Au quotidien, ses équipes gèrent l'encaissement de 2,425 milliards de cotisations AVS et assurance chômage, ainsi que le versement de plus de 876 millions de francs de prestations AVS, AI et allocations perte de gain. En parallèle, elles assurent l'administration des allocations familiales et l'application des conventions collectives de travail.  
Un périmètre technique exigeant, au service de milliers d'entreprises et de leurs assurés "" où chaque dossier a un impact direct sur la vie professionnelle et sociale des personnes concernées.  
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
Description du poste  
Votre mission :  
Au sein de la FER CIAM Genève, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la gestion et la sécurisation des créances des institutions affiliées. Vous pilotez les dossiers de contentieux, de poursuites et de faillites, assurez le suivi des procédures civiles et pénales ainsi que les actions en réparation du dommage, tout en accompagnant les affiliés et en collaborant étroitement avec les autorités et les partenaires internes. Votre rigueur et votre expertise permettent de garantir une gestion efficace des dossiers et la préservation des intérêts des institutions représentées.  
Vos activités principales :  
Gestion des procédures de faillite  
· Réceptionner et traiter les actes des offices des poursuites et des faillites, établir les productions de créances, contrôler les paiements et mouvements (imputation, annulation de poursuite, réclamation de frais)  
· Contrôler les actes de défaut de biens, les procès\-verbaux de saisie et les états de collocation, et engager les actions de suivi nécessaires  
· Suivre les procédures de mainlevée, gérer les correspondances et les frais associés et tenir un échéancier rigoureux des dossiers.  
Actions en réparation du dommage et procédures pénales  
· Rédiger les décisions et suivre les procédures civiles à l'encontre des organes responsables (ARD) dans le cadre de la CIAM  
· Rédiger les plaintes pénales (CIAM et CIEPP) et suivre les procédures pénales engagées contre les entreprises et leurs organes  
· Imputer les paiements reçus dans le cadre des procédures pénales et des actions ARD, et suivre les arrangements relatifs à l'ensemble des procédures.  
Relation avec les affiliés, appui au service juridique, implication dans les projets informatiques  
· Accueillir les affiliés en présentiel et au téléphone, et traiter l'ensemble de la correspondance relative à leurs dossiers  
· Gérer les négociations avec les affiliés et rendre les décisions de sursis au paiement et d'arrangements, dans le cadre fixé par la hiérarchie  
· Préparer les dossiers de pièces à transmettre au service juridique pour les procédures les plus complexes  
· Participation aux projets informatiques du service, notamment pour assurer les tests.  
Profil recherché  
Votre Profil  
Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC d'employé(e) de commerce ou d'une formation jugée équivalente  
Vous avez une expérience préalable dans le contentieux ou dans un office de poursuites ou de faillite  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation certifiante en exécution forcée (atout)  
Vous possédez de bonnes connaissances en matière de taxation et de perception des cotisations paritaires AVS/AI/APG/AC et autres tâches dédiées  
Vous possédez de solides capacités d'analyses de mouvements comptables, de suivi des créances et de contrôle des paiements  
Vous avez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et une parfaite maîtrise de la langue française  
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques usuels (Word, Excel et Outlook)  
Vous êtes de nationalité suisse ou titulaire d'un permis valable.  
Aptitudes et compétences  
Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour les assurances sociales et/ou la loi sur la poursuite pour dettes et la faillite  
Vous faites preuve d'organisation, de fiabilité et de précision dans l'exécution de votre travail.  
Vous possédez une bonne capacité d'écoute et communiquez avec clarté et diplomatie  
Vous êtes capable de travailler de ère autonome tout en accordant une grande importance à l'entraide, à la collaboration et à une ambiance de travail positive.  
Notre offre :  
Un poste varié et à responsabilité au sein de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse, dans un environnement en constante évolution.  
Vous bénéficierez :  
\- D'un environnement stimulant et collaboratif  
\- De possibilités de formation continue  
\- D'avantages sociaux compétitifs  
\- D'un équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle respecté  
Ce poste vous intéresse ? Alors postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre la FER CIAM. jpid0e7a3b0jm jit0832jm jiy26jm

Afin de soutenir notre service dans le cadre d’un remplacement congé maternité, nous recherchons pour notre établissement l’EMS Mont\-Riant à Yverdon\-les\-Bains, qui accueille 56 Personnes et qui est spécialisé dans le domaine de la psychiatrie de l’âge avancé :  
Infirmier·ère (F/H/D) En CDI à 80% \- EMS Mont\-Riant

Vous gérez l’ensemble des urgences médicales et activerez au besoin les procédures d’urgence. De plus, vous participez aux examens et observations en vue du diagnostic médical. De par vos valeurs centrées sur la Personne, vous établissez une relation de confiance avec les Personnes et leur entourage, en créant un environnement sécuritaire et adapté à leurs besoins.

Sens de l’observation permettant d’évaluer rapidement une situation complexe et d’orienter les interventions pour éviter des hospitalisations ou des chutes

Grand sens des responsabilités et leadership est avéré  
Dynamique, à l’écoute, flexible, adaptable et organisé  
Attitude centrée sur le bien\-être de la Personne  
Maîtrise du français oral et écrit ainsi que la maîtrise des outils informatiques (Carefolio)  
Connaissance du système de santé suisse un atout  
NOUS VOUS OFFRONS  
La possibilité de travailler dans un environnement riche de contacts.  
L’occasion de participer à des projets institutionnels novateurs.  
Des conditions de travail et salariales selon la CCT SAN (convention collective de travail du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois). Classe 17\-19 et selon expérience.  
L’opportunité de maintenir et développer vos compétences grâce à un programme de formations internes variées.  
ENTRÉE EN FONCTION  
Dès le 1er novembre 2026 ou à convenir

description:
L’entreprise et vous  
Chez Services Plus Énergies (SP  
Exploitant d’installations CVC (H/F)  
L’entreprise et vous  
Chez Services Plus Énergies (SPE), nous accompagnons nos clients dans les métiers du chauffage, de la ventilation et de la climatisation, avec une forte exigence de qualité, de réactivité et de fiabilité.  
Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre métier, nous recherchons un·e Exploitant·e d’installations CVC pour prendre en charge un parc d’installations et en assurer le bon fonctionnement au quotidien.  
Ce rôle va bien au\-delà de la simple surveillance technique. En tant qu’Exploitant·e, vous êtes responsable de vos installations : vous suivez leur état, anticipez les dérives, réalisez les interventions nécessaires et contribuez directement au confort des habitants, tout en veillant à limiter les consommations d’énergie.  
Vous devenez progressivement l’interlocuteur de référence sur votre parc, reconnu pour votre connaissance des installations, votre réactivité et votre capacité à faire avancer les sujets avec sérieux et bon sens.

À propos de l'entreprise  
Chez Services Plus Énergies (SPE), nous accompagnons nos clients dans les métiers du chauffage, de la ventilation et de la climatisation, avec une exigence constante de qualité, de réactivité et de fiabilité.  
À propos du rôle  
Un rôle terrain à forte responsabilité, au coeur du confort des habitants et de la performance énergétique des bâtiments. Responsabilités  
Exploitation d'un parc d'installations : suivi régulier des équipements, contrôle du bon fonctionnement et détection des anomalies.  
Maintenance préventive : contrôles, réglages, vérifications et interventions planifiées.  
Interventions correctives : diagnostic de pannes, premières réparations et coordination des interventions spécialisées lorsque nécessaire.  
Suivi de la performance : observation des dérives, remontée des dysfonctionnements et contribution à l'efficience énergétique.  
Relation client et occupants : communication claire, attitude professionnelle et sens du service.  
Reporting terrain : rédaction des rapports d'intervention et mise à jour fiable des données liées aux installations.  
Collaboration interne : échanges réguliers avec les responsables, le dispatching, les autres exploitants et les autres départements.  
Service de piquet : participation au tournus de piquet afin d'assurer la continuité de service sur le parc SPE.  
Qualifications  
Une formation technique dans le domaine CVC ou de la maintenance en bâtiment.  
Compétences requises  
Une expérience dans le domaine CVC, chauffage, ventilation, maintenance technique du bâtiment ou exploitation d'installations.  
Une bonne compréhension des installations techniques et des contraintes terrain.  
La capacité à réaliser des diagnostics et à intervenir avec méthode.  
Un profil proactif·ve, autonome, fiable et organisé·e dans le suivi de vos interventions.  
Le sens du service et une attitude professionnelle.  
De l'aisance avec les outils numériques (suivi des interventions, rapports terrain).  
Le permis de conduire.  
Le permis de manipulation des fluides frigorigènes est un plus.  
Une habilitation ou autorisation de type OIBT –15 est un véritable atout.

title: Marketing Specialist – Technology & Transformation Consulting Services,24323 100%
description:
Location: Zurich
Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%

About the Opportunity    

We are looking for a dynamic, collaborative and results-driven Marketing Specialist for our Technology & Transformation consulting business. In this role, you will help shape and execute integrated marketing campaigns that strengthen the positioning of our consulting business in Switzerland and support our growth ambitions.

Working closely with consulting leaders and subject matter experts, you will develop and deliver innovative, ROI-focused marketing initiatives that engage senior business audiences and address today's most pressing business topics, including Artificial Intelligence, digital transformation, sustainability and strategic technology alliances.

You will partner with stakeholders across Switzerland, Europe and our global network to bring compelling go-to-market strategies to life, create meaningful client experiences, and continuously optimise campaign performance through data-driven insights. This role is based at our Zurich headquarters.

How you can make an impact
-Lead the execution of key go-to-market campaigns for our Technology & Transformation consulting business, providing strategic marketing guidance, ensuring strong alignment with business priorities, and delivering measurable commercial impact
-Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels, leveraging the full marketing mix to drive awareness, engagement and business growth
-Create engaging content for digital marketing channels, including web, email, social media and thought leadership campaigns
-Coordinate online and in-person client engagement initiatives, including events, webinars, sponsorship activations and executive programmes
-Produce compelling client-facing marketing assets and sales enablement materials that effectively communicate our value proposition
-Support campaigns targeting senior executive audiences, including CEOs, Chief Technology Officers, Chief Strategy Officers, Chief Innovation Officers and other C-suite decision-makers
-Measure campaign performance, analyse ROI, client engagement and market trends, and translate insights into recommendations that continuously improve marketing effectiveness and differentiation
-Monitor competitor activity and emerging market trends to identify opportunities and strengthen our market positioning
-Collaborate with marketing colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and our global network to share best practices, leverage global assets and deliver consistent, high-quality campaigns

Who we are looking for
-Relevant degree in marketing or related fields
3-5 years of marketing experience, of which ideally some in a professional services firm
-Proven track record in creating and executing integrated campaigns across all marketing channels and targeting a senior business audience
-Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
-Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business topics into engaging marketing content
-Analytical mindset with experience measuring campaign performance and using data to optimise marketing effectiveness
-Experience with CRM, marketing automation and content management platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo or similar tools) is an advantage.
-Fluency in English and German or French

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to work on some of today's most relevant business topics while partnering with senior leaders across our Consulting practice and international marketing network. If you enjoy combining creativity with data-driven marketing, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are passionate about creating impactful campaigns that drive business results, we'd love to hear from you.

Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective help us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.

In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.

Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers.

How to apply

We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV and cover letter.

If you have any questions, please contact Stefanie Niklas at talent@deloitte.ch

We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law.
Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today.

Conseiller/ère en voyages d’affaires (80%) Français \- Anglais Mission de durée déterminée  
Fondée le 14 avril 1900 à Paris, l’Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI) est l’instance faîtière du cyclisme dans le monde. Sa mission consiste à développer et superviser le cyclisme sous toutes ses formes et pour tout le monde, en tant que sport de compétition, activité de loisir saine et comme moyen de transport. L’UCI assure par ailleurs la promotion de ses propres événements, notamment des Championnats du Monde Route UCI, manifestation annuelle emblématique, et d’un grand nombre d’autres Championnats du Monde et Coupes du Monde dans les différentes disciplines. Son siège se trouve à Aigle, en Suisse, au Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI.  
L’UCI est à la recherche d’un(e) :  
Conseiller/ère en voyages d’affaires (80%) Français \- Anglais Mission de durée déterminée  
Mission :  
Gestion des voyages des collaborateurs, de la direction ainsi que de toute personne devant voyager pour l’Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI) et pour le Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI (CMC UCI).  
Principales responsabilités :  
Réservations de voyages d’affaires individuels (vol en GDS, low\-cost, billet de train, voitures de location et hébergements) : analyse des demandes, recherche des disponibilités au meilleur prix, envoi des offres aux voyageurs et finalisation de la réservation  
Réservation et coordination lors d’évènement : suivi de liste de participants et réservations des voyages en coordination avec les différentes parties prenantes en charge de l’événement  
Réservation de services auxiliaires : bagages supplémentaires, transport d’équipement de sport  
Vérification des décomptes de cartes de crédit.  
Profil :  
Formation d’agent de voyage ou formation jugée équivalente  
3 à 5 minimum d’expérience dans la gestion et la réservation de voyages d’affaires  
Maîtrise d’Amadeus  
Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit  
Forte orientation clientèle  
Sens de l’organisation et des priorités  
Précision et discrétion  
Capacité à travailler de ère autonome et en équipe  
Esprit d’initiative  
Bonne gestion du stress et de la pression.  
Entrée en fonction et durée de la mission : septembre 2026 au 31 octobre 2027\.  
Nous rejoindre, c’est avoir l’opportunité d’exploiter vos compétences, de participer à l’actualité sportive et de contribuer au succès d’une organisation moderne et dynamique. Si ce poste vous intéresse et que vous correspondez au profil, merci de faire parvenir votre dossier complet (lettre de motivation, CV, certificats de travail et diplômes) par e\-mail à l’adresse suivante : [Écrire un email](<>). jpidd31bbd5jm jit0832jm jiy26jm

title: Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager
description:
Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager  
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. Hoffmann\-La Roche AG in Basel, we are looking for a  
Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager 80\-100%  
Background:  
This role is responsible for the operational and strategic management of clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly outsourced to a global network of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). Operating within a strictly regulated GxP/GMP environment, the position serves as the central operational link between internal supply chain functions, procurement, and external manufacturing partners.  
The core focus encompasses end\-to\-end CMO project execution—from initial onboarding, RFPs, and SOW contracting to budget ownership, SAP order processing, and active S\&OP representation. The goal is to ensure reliable, high\-quality, and cost\-effective clinical supply delivery to meet global trial timelines.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
CMO Site Management: Organize and oversee clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production outsourced to a global network of CMOs.  
Project \& Delivery Oversight: Proactively manage CMO project onboarding, communications, timelines, and delivery performance for outsourced clinical packaging orders to meet supply chain needs while adhering to cost and quality standards.  
Procurement \& Contracting: Partner with Procurement and key stakeholders to drive Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Statements of Work (SOWs), negotiate supply agreements, and select vendors.  
Strategy \& Budgeting: Support leadership in defining supply strategies for non\-standard supply chains. Own the budgeting process and submission for CMO project variable costs.  
Process Ownership \& Governance: Establish team scope and division of responsibilities with upstream functions (e.g., device CMO team). Define, track, and report CMO team KPIs.  
S\&OP Representation: Actively drive network supply outcomes and represent the CMO function in the CD\&OP process.  
Managing operational orders, and master data in SAP  
Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): Lead SRM activities and partner with CMOs to ensure long\-term capability and capacity for predictable delivery.  
Financial \& Order Execution: Create and maintain Purchase Orders in the purchasing system, review/approve CMO invoices, and execute pre\- and post\-production order management in the ERP system.  
Continuous Improvement: Identify and champion process improvement opportunities, applying technical expertise to resolve complex supply chain issues. Serve as an SME/primary contact for key strategic initiatives.  
Must Haves:  
Degree: BA/BS degree, preferably in a technical, business, or supply chain discipline. Master’s degree is a plus  
Work Experience: 8\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, supply chain management, or manufacturing.  
Domain Knowledge: Strong preference for experience in clinical drug manufacturing, clinical supply chain, or contract manufacturing management.  
GMP Experience: Required.  
IT / Tool Skills: Proficient knowledge and hands\-on experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems.  
Language Skills: Excellent written and spoken English (required); basic German skills are beneficial.  
Shift Flexibility: Flexibility to adapt to global working hours (e.g., starting as early as 7:00 AM for SSF teams or working until 6:00 PM for Switzerland\-based teams).  
Solid understanding of pharma supply chains, contract manufacturing, and clinical operations.  
Proven project planning, project management, and resource management skills.  
Strong leadership experience in taking projects from initiation through final delivery.  
High cultural awareness and social competence for global stakeholder management.  
Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and system\-oriented skills with high attention to detail.  
High integrity and the ability to operate independently with minimal direction.  
Excellent cross\-functional communication and presentation skills.  
Nice to Have:  
Professional certifications: APICS, SCOR, or equivalent relevant experience.  
Process/Management training: PMP, Operational Excellence, Six Sigma, or Lean methodologies.  
What you will be offered:  
An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies  
Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas  
Central location in Basel  
Varied job profile  
Further training opportunities through temptraining  
Working in a dynamic and motivated team

Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration et piloter des actions d'optimisation visant à accroître la productivité, la qualité et la fiabilité des procédés d'usinage.  
Être le référent technique en matière d'outils de coupe auprès des équipes internes (méthodes, production, industrialisation...) ainsi que des partenaires externes.  
Accompagner les ateliers de production en apportant un support technique et en contribuant à la résolution des problématiques liées aux outils de coupe.  
Assurer une veille technologique active sur les innovations du marché en participant à des salons professionnels, en réalisant des essais et des études de faisabilité afin d'intégrer les meilleures solutions techniques

Titulaire d'un CFC de polymécanicien, ou d'un diplôme de Technicien ES.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les logiciels de CAO/FAO, idéalement CREO.  
Vous maitrisez les vitesses de coupe, et avez des bases sur les lubrifiants.  
Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif et aimez être au plus près du terrain pour accompagner les équipes.  
Reconnu pour votre rigueur et votre méthode, vous disposez d'un bon esprit d'analyse et savez proposer des solutions concrètes et efficaces.  
Doté d'un excellent relationnel, vous communiquez avec aisance auprès d'interlocuteurs variés et favorisez les échanges transversaux.  
Curieux et adaptable, vous évoluez avec facilité dans des environnements techniques variés, en lien avec les équipes d'industrialisation, les ateliers de production et les fournisseurs.

title: Senior AI Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
description:
Senior AI Infrastructure \& Platform Engineer (Basel)  
Description of the company  
Our client is a well\-established financial institution known for its long\-standing stability, international footprint, and commitment to operational excellence. The organisation fosters a collaborative culture, values expertise, and promotes continuous improvement across its global technology and data functions.  
Role \& Responsibilities  
As Senior AI Infrastructure \& Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, operating and continuously improving enterprise\-grade AI infrastructure platforms supporting advanced machine learning and generative AI initiatives. You will work closely with infrastructure, platform engineering and data science teams to build highly available GPU\-enabled environments and scalable container platforms capable of supporting large\-scale model training and inference workloads.  
Key Responsibilities:  
Design, implement and operate GPU\-enabled infrastructure platforms for AI and machine learning workloads  
Administer and optimize Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms supporting enterprise AI services  
Manage high\-performance computing (HPC) environments, including bare\-metal and virtualized GPU systems  
Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform and GitOps methodologies  
Troubleshoot complex platform issues involving Linux, networking, storage, Kubernetes and GPU architectures  
Support AI and data science teams with platform provisioning, resource allocation and operational excellence  
Implement platform monitoring and observability solutions  
Participate in incident management and on\-call rotations  
Candidate Profile  
You hold a university\-level degree in Computer Science or a related discipline and bring several years of current, hands\-on experience operating large\-scale Linux and containerized infrastructure environments.  
Additionally:  
Minimum 5 years of enterprise infrastructure engineering experience  
Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience administering Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments  
Proven experience operating Kubernetes and/or OpenShift platforms in production environments  
Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform, ArgoCD and Ansible  
Practical experience supporting NVIDIA GPU infrastructures and GPU\-enabled computing environments  
Knowledge of GPU architectures and technologies such as NVLink, PCIe switching and GPU virtualization  
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana and infrastructure monitoring solutions  
Strong Shell and scripting capabilities  
Experience working in highly regulated enterprise environments is advantageous  
Fluent in English; German advantageous  
Valid CH work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship required  
Willingness to work 100% on\-site  
Benefits:  
Central city office locations across Switzerland  
Above average insurance coverage fully borne our client  
Contribution to health insurance and meal allowance  
Excellent opportunities for further training and personal development

Expérience de management et de direction de plusieurs années dans un environnement exigeant  
Expérience concernant les questions de formation, les systèmes de formation initiale ou la conception de programmes de formation  
Inclination pour le numérique et expérience concernant les formats d’enseignement numériques  
Connaissance du système suisse d’EDSP et de ses structures fédéralistes, ou disposition à s’y familiariser rapidement  
Expérience dans le secteur public ou dans un environnement parapublic ou politique  
Expérience en gestion de parties prenantes et en travail en réseau reposant sur la coopération  
Capacité à concilier des intérêts différents de ère constructive et à concevoir des solutions viables  
Intégrité absolue, solide sens de la communication et compréhension réfléchie du management  
Très bonne connaissance du français et de l’allemand et, de préférence, connaissances en italien

Un poste à responsabilités correspondant à une fonction de management d’importance nationale

title: Infirmier·ère référent en Santé Mentale
description:
Infirmier(e) référent(e) en Santé Mentale \- 80%\-100%  
Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population de l'Ouest Lausannois des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.  
En rejoignant l'APREMADOL, vous vous engagez de manière concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.  
Vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des clients. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.  
Afin de compléter nos équipes, l'APREMADOL recherche de suite ou à convenir un\-e :  
Infirmier·ère référent·e en Santé Mentale (80\-100%)  
Votre mission  
En tant qu’infirmier·ère référent·e, vous assurez le rôle de responsable de situation. Vous réalisez et déléguez des prestations de qualité afin de garantir la santé, la sécurité et le bien\-être des client·e·s à domicile, en identifiant leurs problématiques sociales. Sur leur lieu de vie, vous définissez avec eux les solutions les plus adaptées à leur situation, développant ainsi une relation de confiance privilégiée.  
Découvrez\-en plus sur ce métier en visionnant la vidéo sous cette annonce.  
Vos responsabilités  
Assurer la responsabilité du rôle de référent auprès des clients présentant des troubles relevant de la santé mentale et/ou de la psychogériatrie  
Evaluer et mettre en place les prestations en fonction des besoins du client·e et de son entourage et fournir les prestations prévues dans le plan d'intervention, en menant des entretiens d’évaluation, d’orientation, de conseil ainsi que d’appui dans les démarches administratives et financières  
Assurer les prestations de soins médico\-délégués, d’hygiène et de confort ainsi que l’accompagnement auprès de nos client·e·s  
Accompagner les collaborateurs auxiliaires afin de garantir la qualité des prestations  
Créer et entretenir des liens durables avec les partenaires du réseau médico\-social régional (y compris les bénévoles et les groupes d'usagers)  
Mobiliser les compétences pluridisciplinaires de l’équipe de soins du CMS, tout en les sensibilisant aux problèmes posés par une prise en charge psychiatrique ou psycho\-gériatrique et en proposant des mesures de prévention  
Documenter le dossier informatisé du client selon les directives institutionnelles pour permettre la continuité des soins  
Votre profil et vos compétences :  
Bachelor en soins infirmiers HES ou titre équivalent ( reconnaissance du titre étranger par la Croix\-Rouge suisse), avec spécialisation en santé mentale  
Minimum 6 mois d'expérience en soins psychiatriques  
Bonnes connaissances du domaine socio\-sanitaire suisse (premier emploi en Suisse)  
Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse  
Bonne maîtrise de la langue française avec des solides compétences rédactionnelles  
Capacité d’organisation, de gestion des priorités et de prise d’initiatives  
Bonnes connaissances des outils informatiques usuels  
Capacité à communiquer et à négocier  
Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire.  
Nous offrons  
Des horaires principalement de journée (7h30–17h00\), avec seulement un soir travaillé toutes les deux semaines jusqu’à 22h00 et un week\-end travaillé toutes les huit semaines.  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération selon la CCT du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois.  
Une prévoyance professionnelle de qualité, au\-delà des minima légaux.  
5 semaines de vacances par an, puis 6 semaines dès 50 ans.  
Des perspectives de formation continue et d’évolution au sein du réseau AVASAD.  
Un environnement professionnel stimulant et humainement riche, au service du bien\-être des client·e·s.

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Materials Engineer - Polymers and Composites
description:
What you'll do:
You will join CERN's Polymer Laboratory within the Superconducting Magnet Technology section to develop and qualify advanced polymer and composite materials.

You will contribute to the design, validation and implementation of innovative materials, used in CERN accelerator systems within a cryogenic, high-voltage and radiation environment.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop and qualify novel polymer and composite materials for superconducting magnets and accelerator technologies, with particular emphasis on cryogenic operation, high-voltage insulation and radiation resistance.
- Design and validate manufacturing and processing techniques for superconducting magnet insulation systems, including resin transfer processes, bonding technologies, composite fabrication and additive manufacturing.
- Lead research and design projects within the Polymer Laboratory to address the evolving needs of CERN accelerator complex and experimental facilities.
- Contribute to the laboratory developments by identifying material technologies and processing techniques and establishing new experimental capabilities.

Still here?
Let's make a quick check about:

Your profile:
- Experience in polymer and composite materials engineering, including development of manufacturing processes for fibre-reinforced composites.
- Experience in material characterisation techniques, such as mechanical, thermal or chemical analyses.
- Experience coordinating or leading multidisciplinary technical and research and design activities involving multiple stakeholders.
- Knowledge of superconducting magnet construction and technologies, or of materials for cryogenic, high-voltage or radiation environments, would be an asset.
- Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of material engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Knowledge of radiation effects and ageing of materials.
- Knowledge and application of mechanical testing (destructive).
- Knowledge and analysis of materials failure.
- Knowledge, application and processing techniques of polymers and composites.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Takes responsibility for own actions and decisions.
- Identifies, defines and assesses problems, takes action to address them.
- Listens actively to others and lets others speak.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Medical hazard:
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions:
- Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
- Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.

description:
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
FER CIAM "" L'humain au centre des prestations sociales  
La FER CIAM est l'agence genevoise de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse FER Genève, créée par la FER Genève et pleinement intégrée dans son écosystème de services aux entreprises membres.  
Avec près de 47'500 affiliés "" entreprises et indépendants confondus "" elle est l'un des acteurs incontournables de la protection sociale en Suisse romande.  
Au quotidien, ses équipes gèrent l'encaissement de 2,425 milliards de cotisations AVS et assurance chômage, ainsi que le versement de plus de 876 millions de francs de prestations AVS, AI et allocations perte de gain. En parallèle, elles assurent l'administration des allocations familiales et l'application des conventions collectives de travail.  
Un périmètre technique exigeant, au service de milliers d'entreprises et de leurs assurés "" où chaque dossier a un impact direct sur la vie professionnelle et sociale des personnes concernées.  
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
Description du poste  
Votre mission :  
Au sein de la FER CIAM Genève, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la gestion et la sécurisation des créances des institutions affiliées. Vous pilotez les dossiers de contentieux, de poursuites et de faillites, assurez le suivi des procédures civiles et pénales ainsi que les actions en réparation du dommage, tout en accompagnant les affiliés et en collaborant étroitement avec les autorités et les partenaires internes. Votre rigueur et votre expertise permettent de garantir une gestion efficace des dossiers et la préservation des intérêts des institutions représentées.  
Vos activités principales :  
Gestion des procédures de faillite  
· Réceptionner et traiter les actes des offices des poursuites et des faillites, établir les productions de créances, contrôler les paiements et mouvements (imputation, annulation de poursuite, réclamation de frais)  
· Contrôler les actes de défaut de biens, les procès\-verbaux de saisie et les états de collocation, et engager les actions de suivi nécessaires  
· Suivre les procédures de mainlevée, gérer les correspondances et les frais associés et tenir un échéancier rigoureux des dossiers.  
Actions en réparation du dommage et procédures pénales  
· Rédiger les décisions et suivre les procédures civiles à l'encontre des organes responsables (ARD) dans le cadre de la CIAM  
· Rédiger les plaintes pénales (CIAM et CIEPP) et suivre les procédures pénales engagées contre les entreprises et leurs organes  
· Imputer les paiements reçus dans le cadre des procédures pénales et des actions ARD, et suivre les arrangements relatifs à l'ensemble des procédures.  
Relation avec les affiliés, appui au service juridique, implication dans les projets informatiques  
· Accueillir les affiliés en présentiel et au téléphone, et traiter l'ensemble de la correspondance relative à leurs dossiers  
· Gérer les négociations avec les affiliés et rendre les décisions de sursis au paiement et d'arrangements, dans le cadre fixé par la hiérarchie  
· Préparer les dossiers de pièces à transmettre au service juridique pour les procédures les plus complexes  
· Participation aux projets informatiques du service, notamment pour assurer les tests.  
Profil recherché  
Votre Profil  
Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC d'employé(e) de commerce ou d'une formation jugée équivalente  
Vous avez une expérience préalable dans le contentieux ou dans un office de poursuites ou de faillite

Vous possédez de solides capacités d'analyses de mouvements comptables, de suivi des créances et de contrôle des paiements  
Vous avez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et une parfaite maîtrise de la langue française  
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques usuels (Word, Excel et Outlook)  
Vous êtes de nationalité suisse ou titulaire d'un permis valable.  
Aptitudes et compétences  
Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour les assurances sociales et/ou la loi sur la poursuite pour dettes et la faillite  
Vous faites preuve d'organisation, de fiabilité et de précision dans l'exécution de votre travail.  
Vous possédez une bonne capacité d'écoute et communiquez avec clarté et diplomatie  
Vous êtes capable de travailler de ère autonome tout en accordant une grande importance à l'entraide, à la collaboration et à une ambiance de travail positive.  
Notre offre :  
Un poste varié et à responsabilité au sein de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse, dans un environnement en constante évolution.

\- D'un environnement stimulant et collaboratif

\- D'avantages sociaux compétitifs  
\- D'un équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle respecté

title: Data Protection & Privacy Specialist
description:
Data Protection \& Privacy Specialist  
Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.  
SICPA sets the pulse of sovereignty, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.  
This position, based in our Headquarters in Prilly and part of the Legal Department and reporting to the Senior Legal Counsel, is essentially dedicated to providing expert data privacy support service to the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer.  
ROLE  
Serve as the primary data privacy support specialist for the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer, fostering a close and effective working relationship to manage data privacy initiatives across the organization.  
In support of the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer and in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, conduct and analyze privacy and data protection assessments for projects, SICPA solutions, and processes involving personal data to ensure adherence to data protection \& privacy requirements.  
Assist the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer by ensuring (i) the continued application of Privacy by Design principles across software, process and architecture Design; and (ii) the compliance with Privacy by Default rules for the business development of SICPA solutions and internal projects.  
Following the training priorities defined by the Head of Data Protection\& Privacy / Data Protection Officer, contribute to promote personal data protection and privacy in Switzerland and overseas.  
Assist the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer in the management of Data Protection risks related to the third parties.  
Coordinate tasks required by our global SICPA trust Intelligence Platform that covers data protection \& privacy requirements to connect data, teams, and processes.  
Assist the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer in the management of the day\-to\-day operations of Data Subject Access Requests and in maintaining and updating SICPA’s records of processing activities.  
Assist the Head of Data Protection \& Privacy / Data Protection Officer to ensure the alignment between the Data Processing Agreements and our specific data protection \& privacy provisions in commercial contracts.  
Provide ad hoc support on legal and privacy\-related matters as required.  
PROFILE  
Master's level qualification, ideally with a focus in Law, Information Security, or related fields.  
Proven experience and knowledge in data protection, cybersecurity, privacy and information security.  
IT knowledge or extended knowledge, strong interest for the new technology landscape  
Ability to review and analyze data privacy provisions in agreements and Data Processing Agreements.  
Intellectually agile, keen to learn with excellent writing and analytical skills.  
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and resolve issues quickly and effectively.  
Motivated and able to work autonomously.  
Very strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Fluent in both English and French.  
WHY JOIN US?  
Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters  
Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation\-driven company  
Collaborate with high\-level experts and work on impactful international projects  
Operate in a multi\-cultural, high\-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged jpidceaaff4jm jpit0832jm jpiy26jm

Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre métier, nous recherchons un·e Exploitant·e d’installations CVC pour prendre en charge un parc d’installations et en assurer le bon fonctionnement au quotidien.  
Ce rôle va bien au\-delà de la simple surveillance technique. En tant qu’Exploitant·e, vous êtes responsable de vos installations : vous suivez leur état, anticipez les dérives, réalisez les interventions nécessaires et contribuez directement au confort des habitants, tout en veillant à limiter les consommations d’énergie.

Exploitation d'un parc d'installations : suivi régulier des équipements, contrôle du bon fonctionnement et détection des anomalies.

Service de piquet : participation au tournus de piquet afin d'assurer la continuité de service sur le parc SPE.

Une formation technique dans le domaine CVC ou de la maintenance en bâtiment.

Une expérience dans le domaine CVC, chauffage, ventilation, maintenance technique du bâtiment ou exploitation d'installations.  
Une bonne compréhension des installations techniques et des contraintes terrain.  
La capacité à réaliser des diagnostics et à intervenir avec méthode.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)  
HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.

title: Clinical Development Lead
description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional eager to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated therapy?

We are seeking a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central role in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

This role offers the opportunity to shape lifecycle evidence generation and unlock the full potential of differentiated medicines through clinically meaningful, scientifically robust and strategically aligned development activities.

Working closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs and Commercial colleagues, you will ensure development plans are scientifically robust, operationally feasible and strategically aligned. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Clinical Development Lead is the clinical and scientific expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:

•    Lead the multidisciplinary Clinical Team at development-program level, providing scientific direction, strategic alignment and accountability across the program.
•    Shape innovative clinical development strategies that maximize the compound's value throughout its lifecycle, integrating emerging scientific evidence and evolving standard of care into development plans.
•    Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•    Provide thought leadership in clinical trial design and execution in close partnership with key functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
•    Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•    Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•    Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•    Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•    Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•    Represent the Company as a credible scientific leader externally with investigators, scientific experts, advisory boards and Health Authorities.
•    Champion the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and support the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements

•    Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc or equivalent.
•    At least eight years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•    Proven experience leading Phase II to IV clinical development programs in global, cross-functional matrix environments through successful planning, delivery and publication.
•    Strong experience supporting global regulatory submissions and Health Authority interactions, including the preparation of key clinical and regulatory documents throughout the development lifecycle.
•    Excellent understanding of global drug development and innovative clinical trial design through all phases, with the ability to integrate preclinical, translational, clinical, and real-world evidence to inform development strategies; pediatric development experience is an advantage.
•    Intellectually curious with strong scientific acumen, entrepreneurial spirit, and learning agility, with the ability to challenge conventional thinking constructively.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence and the ability to effectively communicate complex scientific concepts to diverse internal and external stakeholders
•    Strong project management, prioritization, problem-solving and stakeholder-management capabilities.
•    Ability to work independently, influence decision-making and build alignment across cross-functional teams in a dynamic matrix organization.
•    A collaborative, proactive and pragmatic mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering high-quality clinical evidence.

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics
description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

RBI’s Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence

RBI is strengthening its global procurement organization by establishing a Global Commodities & Intelligence Centre of Excellence (CoE).

The CoE will provide commodity intelligence, data, risk management, and commercial decision support to procurement teams across RBI’s brands and markets. It will act as the analytical backbone of the global procurement function, helping regional teams make faster, data-driven sourcing and negotiation decisions.

Our Opportunity:

The Director, Global Commodity Management & Analytics will build and lead RBI’s newly established CoE, including its operating model, governance, analytical capabilities, tools, and team.

This is a newly created global role for a commercially minded commodity leader with deep market expertise, strong negotiation experience, advanced analytical capabilities, and an interest in using AI and data to improve procurement decisions.

The role will focus primarily on the following direct commodity categories:

Sugar, Wheat, Soy, Corn, Pork, Beef, Chicken, Paperboard, and Potatoes

The CoE will own market intelligence, forecasting, cost modelling, risk management, sourcing strategy, and upstream commercial negotiations for these categories, depending on the market.

The role will also provide advisory intelligence and risk support for selected indirect categories, including metals, steel, engineering, energy, maintenance, repair and operations, and industrial gases.

The CoE will lead or support negotiations for upstream raw materials, including raw meat cuts, agricultural commodities, and packaging feedstocks.

RBI follows a five-day, in-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite five days per week.

Your Roles & Responsibilities:

Build and lead the Global Commodities & Intelligence CoE, establishing its operating model, governance, team structure, priorities, and ways of working with regional and global procurement teams.
Define RBI’s global commodity intelligence strategy, including frameworks for market monitoring, price forecasting, risk assessment, scenario planning, and procurement timing recommendations.
Develop and deploy AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, including forecasting models, real-time market monitoring, should-cost tools, scenario analysis, and executive risk dashboards.
Own RBI’s global commodity risk management strategy, covering forward contracting, index-linked pricing, supplier diversification, pooling opportunities, hedging considerations, and spot, forward, and long-term supply arrangements.
Lead upstream commodity negotiations across the direct category portfolio, from market analysis and strategy development through to supplier engagement and commercial execution, as appropriate by market.
Lead RBI’s Global Contingency and Risk Management Programme, including supply-chain stress testing, inventory and business-continuity planning, geopolitical and weather-risk analysis, reporting, and executive escalation.
Establish global should-cost models, cost benchmarks, and pricing mechanisms that help procurement teams validate supplier proposals and strengthen sourcing and negotiation decisions.
Manage external commodity consultancies, market-data providers, and intelligence platforms, while building an integrated and scalable data infrastructure across markets and functions.
Act as RBI’s global commodity intelligence leader, delivering market outlooks, cost-impact analysis, sourcing recommendations, and executive briefings to senior procurement, finance, and brand leaders.
Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Supply Chain, Operations, R&D, Quality Assurance, Sustainability, and Brand teams to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, supply resilience, responsible sourcing, and stronger procurement governance.

Your skills & experience:

10+ years of progressive experience in global commodity procurement, trading, supply chain risk management, or commodity market intelligence within a large-scale FMCG, food service, QSR, or agri-food business.
Demonstrable expertise across at least three of the nine Direct categories; proven track record of executing upstream raw commodity negotiations at significant scale, including proteins (Beef, Chicken, Pork), grains, oilseeds, or packaging feedstocks.
Strong working knowledge of commodity markets, exchange mechanics (CME, CBOT, ICE), financial risk instruments (futures, options, swaps), and price risk management frameworks.
Proven experience deploying or commissioning AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics tools for commodity forecasting, market monitoring, or procurement decision support.
Experience building or leading a Centre of Excellence, intelligence function, or data capability within a complex global organization.
Track record of managing external consultancies, market data vendors, and analytics platform relationships at enterprise scale.
Experience operating within global matrixed organizations with multiple brands, procurement cooperatives, or franchise networks; able to influence without direct authority across regional structures.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate commodity market dynamics into clear business recommendations and financial impact models.
Excellent communicator and executive presence; comfortable presenting to C-suite and Board-level audiences.
Fluent in English; additional languages (French, German, Spanish, Portuguese) are an asset.

We are looking for:

A seasoned commodity professional who can build and lead a high-impact global intelligence function while also owning the commercial execution of RBI’s upstream raw commodity portfolio. You operate at the intersection of markets, data, and strategy. You are as comfortable at the negotiating table as you are presenting a risk scenario to the Board. You influence regional teams through the quality of your intelligence and the rigor of your commercial outcomes. You are energized by complexity, clarity, and building things that others depend on.

title: Mechanical Technician for CMS Detector Upgrades
description:
What you'll do
As a mechanical technician, you will contribute to upgrade projects of the CMS detector, covering a broad range of responsibilities. These include workshop-based mechanical work, installation of detector systems, and the design and use of tooling for the removal and installation of CMS sub-detectors, as well as radioprotection duties in experimental areas and associated laboratories.

You will also take on coordination and operational responsibilities within the CMS Technical Coordination team, working closely with sub-detector groups and CMS technical support teams.

Your responsibilities
Take responsibility for activities related to safety and radioprotection for subdetector removal and installation, working with CMS safety officers and subdetector teams, operating in radioprotection-classified areas, and applying safety rules.
Manage a mechanical workshop, advising and assisting CMS subdetector teams, ensuring the availability and proper use of equipment and tools, and supplying consumables.
Provide technical support and hands-on assistance to CMS subdetector project teams operating within the CMS laboratories at CERN, in the fields of mechanical manufacturing, assembly, structures, and welding.
Take part in the development, testing, on-site installation, and on-detector operation of custom tooling for subdetectors, working with subdetector technical teams.
Operate and maintain hydraulic, mechanical, and electromechanical systems.
Organise and supervise the storage of subdetector equipment in CMS-reserved spaces at CERN, ensuring proper inventory and space management.
Assist the territorial safety officer of the building where the mechanical workshop is located, supervising work requested on infrastructure for general safety, and using a mobile crane and forklift when needed.
Serve as the technical contact for mechanical activities with subdetector teams and for space areas under your responsibility, reporting regularly to the Technical Coordination managers.

Your profile
Experience in radioprotection and the ability to work in classified areas.
Proven ability to manage a mechanical workshop, including the use of standard machines and tools.
Strong organisational skills for coordinating teamwork and on-site technical activities.
Proficiency in reading 2D and 3D technical drawings and manufacturing mechanical parts accordingly; experience in producing 2D and 3D drawings is an asset.
Solid background in the design, construction, and assembly of mechanical components and customised tooling.
Experience in the installation of structures and the use of specialised tooling for handling large equipment.

Integration of mechanical systems.
Team management.
Knowledge of regulatory framework and best practice in radiation protection.

Takes responsibility for own actions and decisions.

Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.

Exposure to ionizing radiation and classified as category A.

title: Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert
description:
Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert

Location: Geneva, Switzerland

At Bunge, Trade Finance Solution is far more than transaction processing. It is a critical function that supports financing of global commodity flows, business growth, and protects the organization from financial and operational risk.

As our Trade Finance Solutions (TFS) business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert to join our team. Acting as a key control layer between commercial teams, banking partners, and operational execution, you will help ensure that complex Trade Finance transactions are appropriately structured, documented, risk-assessed, and executed in line with internal policies and international Trade Finance standards.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Commodity Trade Finance Operations professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, influencing critical business decisions, being closed to the execution of the Trade Finance instruments and working at the intersection of banking, risk management, and global trade.

What You'll Be Doing
As a subject matter expert within the Trade Finance Solutions team, you will provide oversight, risk control, and advisory support for complex Commodity Trade Finance transactions.

Working closely with Commercial, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Operations, and international banking partners, you will help ensure transactions are structured correctly, risks are understood and mitigated, and controls are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
Reviewing, structuring, and validating Structured Letters of Credit and Trade Finance documentation.
Providing expert advice on transaction structures, Letter of credit wording, risk mitigation, and compliance requirements.
Assessing and approving complex and non-standard transactions, including multi-bank and cross-border financing structures.
Acting as a key control layer between commercial structuring and operational execution.
Supporting and guiding global execution teams on complex transactions, exceptions, and best practices.
Collaborating with banks, clients, and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction lifecycle.
Monitoring transaction accuracy, financial flows, and operational controls by ensuring timely, precise and efficient execution.
Driving operational excellence through strong governance, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

Why This Role Is Different
This is not a traditional Trade Finance Operations role.
The team serves as Bunge's center of expertise for complex and Structured Trade Finance transactions. While standardized operational activities are performed by global execution teams, your focus will be on transaction oversight, risk assessment, decision-making, advisory support, and control effectiveness.

You will have the opportunity to:
Work on sophisticated Trade Finance structures supporting global commodity trading activities.
Partner directly with leading international banks and financial institutions.
Influence business decisions on high-value and strategically important transactions.
Act as a trusted advisor and recognized Trade Finance expert across the organization.
Contribute to the continued growth of a global Trade Finance Solutions business.

What We're Looking For
We're seeking an experienced Trade Finance professional who combines deep technical expertise with commercial awareness, sound judgment, and a strong control mindset.

Required Experience
6+ years of experience in Trade Finance within a bank, commodity trading company, or international trade environment.
Experience in Commodity Trade Finance.
Expertise in Letters of Credit, Stand-by LC and guarantees
Deep knowledge in ICC rules and their application (UCP 600, ISBP, ISP98, URC 522, Incoterms)
Experience reviewing and validating complex banking and Trade Finance documentation.
Strong analytical, risk assessment, and decision-making capabilities.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across locations, functions, and cultures.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word.
Experience coaching, mentoring, or training colleagues.

Preferred Experience

Structured Trade Finance or Transactional Financing products.
Receivables financing, collateral management, or loan administration.
SAP knowledge.
Additional languages such as French or Spanish.

What Will Make You Successful
You perform exceptionally well in complex, high-pressure environments that demand agility and sound decision-making. You consistently navigate competing priorities, balancing commercial goals, operational execution, and risk management while maintaining a focus on business outcomes. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves, and actively contribute to execution when required to drive results and support your team.
You are a collaborative and adaptable team player who enjoys working across cultures and geographies and time zones. You value strong governance, standardized processes, and operational discipline while remaining agile and solution-oriented.

Why Join
This is a unique opportunity to join a global leader in agribusiness and commodities, to brin your expertise in Trade Finance and letter of credit and become part of a highly specialized Trade Finance team at the heart of international commodity flows.

In this role, you will:
Work on high-value, Structured Trade Finance transactions supporting global commodity trading activities.
Act as a trusted subject matter expert partnering with commercial teams, banks, treasury, legal, accounting, and operations.
Gain exposure to complex and non-standard financing structures, including multi-bank, cross-border, and tailored Trade Finance solutions.
Join a team that serves as Bunge's center of expertise, where technical knowledge, judgment, and advisory capabilities are highly valued.
Build a broad international network and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across diverse geographies and cultures.
Play a visible role in supporting business growth while maintaining a robust control and governance framework.
Influence operational excellence by helping shape standards, processes, and best practices across our global Trade Finance organization.
At Bunge, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and international environment where expertise is recognized, development is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make a difference every day.

Ready to Make an Impact?
Join us and help drive the successful execution of complex Trade Finance Solutions that support global business growth while protecting and strengthening our risk framework.
If you are an experienced Trade Finance professional looking to take on a highly visible and impactful role, we encourage you to apply via the link below and submit your CV in English. We look forward to reviewing your application.
